abstract: Despite their considerable promise, many current medical foundation models remain modality specific and lack transparent reasoning, limiting clinical adoption. To address this gap, we introduce Explainable Vision Language Foundation Model for Medicine (EVLF-FM), a multimodal vision language foundation model that combines broad diagnostic capabilities with fine-grained explainability. The development and testing of EVLF-FM encompassed more than 1.3 million total samples from 18 global datasets across 10 imaging modalities related to six clinical specialties: dermatology, hepatology, ophthalmology, pathology, pulmonology and radiology. External validation employed 13,443 independent test samples from 17 additional datasets across 10 imaging modalities. EVLF-FM supports disease diagnosis, visual question answering and pixel-level visual grounding with reasoning capabilities. In internal validation for disease diagnostics, EVLF-FM achieved the highest average accuracy, 0.895, outperforming leading generalist and specialist models. In medical visual grounding, EVLF-FM also achieved reasonable performance across nine modalities with average accuracy at 0.5 intersection over union (Acc@0.5) of 0.842. External testing further confirmed consistent zero-shot and few-shot performance, with competitive F1 scores despite a smaller model size. A hybrid training strategy combining supervised and visual reinforcement fine-tuning enables EVLF-FM to generate clinically interpretable explanations aligned with visual evidence. Human evaluation of these reasoning outputs using the S.C.O.R.E. framework yielded a high overall mean score of 4.25/5, supporting their clinical interpretability. Current limitations include the need for additional validation across diverse healthcare settings. Prospective clinical studies are required to evaluate the safety, effectiveness and clinical utility of EVLF-FM before routine clinical deployment.

abstract: The incidence of early-onset colorectal cancer (EO-CRC; diagnosed before age 50 years) is increasing worldwide. Although current data indicate that EO-CRC may be biologically distinct from average-onset CRC (AO-CRC; diagnosed at age ≥50 years), molecular differences remain poorly defined. To address this knowledge gap, we generated a single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) atlas from 189 primary CRC tumors (54 EO-CRC, 135 AO-CRC) spanning eight decades of life, with at least 20 tumors in most age decades. Our analyses stratified tumors by microsatellite status and accounted for tumor sidedness, stage, patient sex and neoadjuvant treatment history, modeling age continuously or categorically (EO-CRC versus AO-CRC). Among microsatellite-stable (MSS) tumors, those from younger patients were characterized by increased stromal and decreased epithelial proportions, which we confirmed using multispectral immunofluorescence and machine learning in an external cohort of 712 MSS CRC tumors (18 EO-CRC, 694 AO-CRC). Tumor epithelial cells from young patients exhibited increased expression of long noncoding RNAs and FN1, with a trend toward increased heterogeneity in copy number alterations. MSS left-sided EO-CRC tumors had more cell–cell interactions, with epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition-related signaling pathways (FN1/GDF/ACTIVIN) showing increased, cell type-specific interactions. Our large high-resolution snRNA-seq atlas uncovers age-associated features of CRC and provides a resource for the community to understand EO-CRC biology.

abstract: [Cell metabolism] Bile acids represent one of nature's most chemically diverse and therapeutically important metabolite families. However, the human bile acid metabolome remains largely uncharted, with analytical limitations obscuring potentially thousands of biologically active species present in cells and biofluids. Here, we present MetLLM, a transformer-based language model that learns bile acid modification patterns to prioritize candidate bile acid analogs, and MetSpace, an in silico bile acid chemical landscape containing 3,900 prioritized candidates. Liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrometry analysis of human feces confirmed multiple newly detected and structurally novel bile acids, including MS2141 and MS1281. In vitro functional validation showed that MS2141 modulates M2 receptor-associated Gi/o signaling and alters electrophysiological parameters in human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes. This work expands the searchable bile acid metabolome and provides a computational framework for systematic metabolite discovery.

abstract: In-context learning (ICL), the ability to perform new tasks from a few examples supplied in a prompt, is a defining emergent capability of large language models. Here, we show that ICL emerges in the genome language model Evo 2 and enables biological design. With as few as four examples in the prompt and no additional training, Evo 2 generates realistic metal-binding proteins, de novo antibodies, protein-RNA systems, and entire bacteriophage genomes. For {Phi}X174-like bacteriophage design, ICL surpasses previously fine-tuned models on computational measures of design quality and diversity. Beyond {Phi}X174, conditioning the model with different phage prompts enables us to efficiently design MS2 and M13 genomes in silico without fine-tuning. Iteratively updating the prompt with newly generated phage genomes, which we refer to as genomic chain-of-thought, further improves the diversity of designs while maintaining quality metrics. Paired with an inference engine that accelerates generation up to 35-fold and extends practicable context to a megabase, these results establish ICL as a versatile and efficient paradigm for biological sequence design.

abstract: Vancomycin has a narrow therapeutic window requiring individualized dosing and repeated monitoring, a process health systems delegate from physicians to pharmacists for consistency. We silently deployed PharmaAgent, LLM-based vancomycin dosing agentic systems, at Stanford Hospital for two months and compared high- and low-autonomy configurations, each with and without institutional guidelines. Across 403 dosing events in 316 patients, mean absolute percentage error against the treating pharmacist's order was 21.8% with high autonomy versus 37.8% with low autonomy, and recommendations were within 25% of the order in 73.4% versus 50.9% of events (P < 0.001); a second pharmacist was within 25% in 90.2%. Pharmacist review of 196 out-of-tolerance recommendations found a safety concern in 65.8%, more often with low autonomy (odds ratio 2.37). A higher-autonomy agent that self-debugged its intermediate steps proved more robust than stricter engineering, but neither configuration is ready to dose patients without pharmacist oversight.
zh_abstract: 万古霉素的治疗窗狭窄，需要个体化给药和反复监测，医疗系统为保证一致性将这一过程由医生委托给药师。我们在斯坦福医院静默部署了 PharmaAgent（基于大语言模型的万古霉素给药智能体系统）两个月，并比较了高自主性与低自主性配置，每种配置均分别在使用和不使用机构指南的情况下进行。在 316 例患者的 403 次给药事件中，以主治药师医嘱为参照，高自主性的平均绝对百分比误差为 21.8%，低自主性为 37.8%；推荐剂量与医嘱相差在 25% 以内的事件比例分别为 73.4% 和 50.9%（P < 0.001）；第二位药师与医嘱相差在 25% 以内的比例为 90.2%。药师对 196 条超出容许范围的推荐进行审查，发现 65.8% 存在安全问题，低自主性时更常见（比值比 2.37）。对中间步骤进行自我调试的高自主性智能体比更严格的工程化设计更为稳健，但两种配置均尚不能在没有药师监督的情况下为患者给药。

title: GeoMind: Dancing with Geometric Brain Rhythm on Symmetric Positive Definite Manifolds.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: GeoMind：SPD流形上的脑状态动力学建模
summary: IEEE TMI论文，在对称正定流形上用状态空间模型刻画脑功能连接的动态状态演化。
key_points: 针对脑状态演化的整体动力系统视角
利用功能连接的SPD黎曼几何结构
面向功能神经影像分析的SSM方法
reason: 方法类，摘要无验证规模与对照信息
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] State space model (SSM) is a powerful tool in neuroscience field to characterize the dynamic nature of brain functions by elucidating the mechanism of how brain system transits between brain states and how underlying states give rise to the observed neural activities. Although tremendous efforts have been made to lend the power of deep learning and mathematical insight of SSM in various functional neuroimaging studies, current state-of-the-art methods lack a holistic view of brain state evolution as a self-organized dynamical system where each part of the brain is functionally inter-connected. Since the topological co-activation of functional fluctuations exhibits an intrinsic geometric pattern (symmetric and positive definite, SPD) on the Riemannian manifold, the call for understanding how a selective set of functional connectivities in the brain supports diverse behavior and cognition emerge a new machine learning scenario of manifold-based SSM for largescale functional neuroimages. To that end, we propose a geometric neural network of SSM, coined GeoMind, designed to uncover evolving brain states by tracking the trajectory of functional dynamics on a high-dimensional Riemannian manifold of SPD matrices. GeoMind demonstrates promising results in identifying specific brain states on task-based functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) data, as well as in diseases early diagnosis for Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and Autism, by using resting-state fMRI. These results highlight the applicability of GeoMind in neuroscience research. To further evaluate generalizability of GeoMind, we applied GeoMind to electroencephalography (EEG) emotion datasets, outperforming competing methods and demonstrating scalability across neuroimaging modalities.
zh_abstract: [IEEE医学影像汇刊] 状态空间模型（SSM）是神经科学领域刻画脑功能动态特性的有力工具，可阐明脑系统如何在脑状态之间转换，以及潜在状态如何产生所观察到的神经活动。尽管人们已投入大量努力，将深度学习的能力和 SSM 的数学洞见应用于各类功能神经影像研究，但目前最先进的方法缺乏将脑状态演化视为各部分在功能上相互连接的自组织动力系统的整体视角。由于功能波动的拓扑共激活在黎曼流形上呈现出内在的几何模式（对称正定，SPD），而理解大脑中一组选定的功能连接如何支撑多样的行为和认知，催生了面向大规模功能神经影像的基于流形的 SSM 这一新的机器学习场景。为此，我们提出了一种 SSM 几何神经网络，命名为 GeoMind，旨在通过追踪 SPD 矩阵高维黎曼流形上功能动态的轨迹来揭示演化中的脑状态。GeoMind 在基于任务的功能磁共振成像（fMRI）数据上识别特定脑状态，以及利用静息态 fMRI 对阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和自闭症进行疾病早期诊断方面，均取得了良好的结果。这些结果凸显了 GeoMind 在神经科学研究中的适用性。为进一步评估 GeoMind 的泛化能力，我们将其应用于脑电图（EEG）情绪数据集，其表现优于对比方法，并显示出跨神经影像模态的可扩展性。

title: Patient trust in health education attributed to generative artificial intelligence versus a physician: a randomized survey study of pregnant and postpartum women.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 孕产妇对生成式AI与医生所写健康教育内容的信任：随机调查
summary: 预注册随机调查，400名孕期或产后美国成年人阅读同一篇健康教育文章，作者标注为医生、生成式AI、医生+AI或无作者，比较其对内容与医生的信任。
key_points: 四组随机：医生、AI、混合署名、无署名
共招募400人，80%通过时间与注意力检查
评估文章参与度、内容信任及对医生的信任
reason: 随机设计但为单次在线调查，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To compare patient trust in educational health contentand the physician providing it, when authorship is attributed to a physician or generative artificial intelligence (AI). In a preregistered randomized, parallel survey study, participants read a health education article. Individuals were randomized to 1 of 4 conditions, attributing authorship of an identical article to (1) a physician author, (2) generative AI, (3) a physician assisted by AI (hybrid authorship), or (4) no author. Pregnant or postpartum English-speaking US adults (n = 400) were recruited in August-October 2025 via an online survey panel. Eighty percent passed timing and attention checks. Participants rated article engagement, content trust, and trust in the (hypothetical) recommending physician with Likert-scales. Bonferroni corrections were applied to post hoc pairwise comparisons (α = 0.05). Among participants who correctly recalled authorship (n = 195), AI-only authorship was associated with lower trust in content (mean, 9.43 vs 11.11; P = .001) and the recommending physician (mean, 8.93 vs 10.84; P = .03) compared with physician-only authorship, while hybrid authorship did not differ significantly from physician-only authorship for either outcome (content: P = .08; physician: P > .99). Sensitivity analyses including all participants (n = 321) were generally consistent with the primary findings. Engagement did not differ significantly across conditions in the primary analytic sample. As generative AI becomes increasingly integrated into clinical care, how AI involvement and physician oversight are communicated to patients could have important implications for patient trust. AI authorship was associated with reduced trust in patient-facing education despite identical, clinician-written content.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 比较当健康教育内容的作者被标注为医生或生成式人工智能（AI）时，患者对该教育内容及提供该内容的医生的信任度。在一项预先注册的随机平行调查研究中，参与者阅读了一篇健康教育文章。参与者被随机分配至4种条件之一，将同一篇文章的作者归属分别标注为：（1）医生作者，（2）生成式AI，（3）由AI辅助的医生（混合署名），或（4）无作者。2025年8月至10月通过在线调查平台招募了说英语的美国妊娠或产后成年人（n = 400）。其中80%通过了计时和注意力检查。参与者采用李克特量表对文章的参与度、内容信任度以及对（假设的）推荐医生的信任度进行评分。事后两两比较采用Bonferroni校正（α = 0.05）。在正确回忆出作者归属的参与者中（n = 195），与仅医生署名相比，仅AI署名与较低的内容信任度（均值 9.43 vs 11.11；P = .001）和对推荐医生的信任度（均值 8.93 vs 10.84；P = .03）相关，而混合署名与仅医生署名在这两项结局上均无显著差异（内容：P = .08；医生：P > .99）。纳入所有参与者（n = 321）的敏感性分析结果总体上与主要发现一致。在主要分析样本中，各条件之间的参与度无显著差异。随着生成式AI日益融入临床诊疗，如何向患者传达AI的参与情况和医生的监督，可能对患者信任具有重要影响。尽管内容完全相同且由临床医生撰写，AI署名仍与面向患者的教育内容信任度降低相关。

title: Would Artificial Intelligence Make 'Good' Decisions About Thyroid Nodule Biopsies?
source: PubMed · The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism
zh_title: AI能否对甲状腺结节穿刺做出“好”的决策？
summary: 以100个临床情景比较94名临床医生与多个LLM在甲状腺结节是否穿刺上的判断，评估临床均势情境下的一致性，并以确定性算法作临时基准。
key_points: 100个甲状腺结节病例情景，二分类穿刺/不穿刺
对比94名医生与GPT-5、Claude、Llama、Deepseek等
用Krippendorff's alpha评估一致性
reason: 同行评审，人机对照评估，但为情景式研究、无真实临床结局
abstract: [The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism] Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for clinical decision support (CDS), but evaluation under clinical equipoise-scenarios lacking a consensus correct answer-remains rare. We evaluated commercially available LLM performance for thyroid nodule biopsy recommendations under clinical equipoise. One hundred clinical vignettes describing patients with incidentally discovered thyroid nodules of varying sizes and risk features were presented to 94 clinicians, recruited by convenience sampling from professional networks, and multiple LLMs (GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 3.5/4.0/4.5, Llama 3.2-90B, Deepseek R1, and OpenEvidence). Responses were dichotomized as biopsy versus no biopsy. Agreement was assessed using Krippendorff's alpha, and a deterministic algorithm served as a provisional benchmark. Selected LLM responses were reviewed by experts. Clinicians recommended biopsy in 58% of responses (95% CI 50%, 66%), with unanimous responses in only 50 vignettes. LLM biopsy rates ranged from 46% (Claude 3.5) to 74% (Llama 3.2-90B). LLM-clinician agreement was moderate (α = 0.372-0.453). Agreement with the deterministic algorithm ranged from high (α = 0.954, Detailed TIRADS GPT-5) to low (α = 0.265, Claude Sonnet 4.5). Llama 3.2-90B recommended biopsy in 8 of 8 cases where clinicians unanimously recommended against it. LLMs differed meaningfully in biopsy recommendation patterns, with potential population-level consequences. Evaluating and aligning LLMs for CDS under equipoise requires stakeholders and processes analogous to clinical guideline committees. Because LLMs used as CDS could powerfully disseminate different practice patterns, this creates new responsibilities for guidelines committees and other stakeholders.
zh_abstract: [临床内分泌与代谢杂志] 大语言模型（LLM）在临床决策支持（CDS）方面已显示出前景，但在临床均势（clinical equipoise，即缺乏公认正确答案的情形）下的评估仍然罕见。我们评估了市售 LLM 在临床均势下对甲状腺结节活检建议的表现。我们编写了100个临床病例情景，描述偶然发现甲状腺结节、结节大小及风险特征各异的患者，并呈现给通过专业人际网络以便利抽样方式招募的94名临床医生，以及多个 LLM（GPT-5、Claude Sonnet 3.5/4.0/4.5、Llama 3.2-90B、Deepseek R1 和 OpenEvidence）。回答被二分为活检与不活检。采用 Krippendorff's alpha 评估一致性，并以一种确定性算法作为暂定基准。部分 LLM 的回答由专家进行了审阅。临床医生在58%的回答中建议活检（95% CI 50%，66%），仅50个病例情景的回答完全一致。LLM 的活检建议率从46%（Claude 3.5）到74%（Llama 3.2-90B）不等。LLM 与临床医生之间的一致性为中等（α = 0.372-0.453）。与确定性算法的一致性从高（α = 0.954，Detailed TIRADS GPT-5）到低（α = 0.265，Claude Sonnet 4.5）不等。在临床医生一致反对活检的8个病例中，Llama 3.2-90B 在全部8个病例中均建议活检。LLM 在活检建议模式上存在显著差异，可能带来群体层面的影响。在临床均势下评估并校准用于 CDS 的 LLM，需要类似于临床指南委员会的利益相关方和流程。由于用作 CDS 的 LLM 可能有力地传播不同的诊疗模式，这为指南委员会及其他利益相关方带来了新的责任。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Rupture Risk Stratification of Small Unruptured Intracranial Aneurysms (≤ 7 mm): A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: AI用于小型未破裂颅内动脉瘤（≤7 mm）破裂风险分层：系统综述与荟萃分析
summary: 该系统综述与荟萃分析汇总评估AI模型预测小型未破裂颅内动脉瘤破裂风险的准确性，并比较不同算法架构，已在PROSPERO注册。
key_points: 指出PHASES、ELAPSS在该亚组接近随机水平
纳入机器学习、深度学习、影像组学及CFD模型
采用三层随机效应模型汇总AUC
reason: 预注册系统综述，但摘要未见具体结论与外部验证
abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Small unruptured intracranial aneurysms (UIAs; ≤ 7 mm) carry collectively significant rupture risk, yet conventional scoring tools (PHASES, ELAPSS) perform near chance-level in this subgroup. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the pooled diagnostic accuracy of AI-based models for rupture risk prediction in small UIAs and compared performance across algorithmic architectures. Prospectively registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251142915) and conducted per PRISMA-DTA/PRISMA-S standards. MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched in October 2025 and updated on June 2026. Eligible studies applied machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), radiomics, or computational fluid dynamics-integrated models to small UIAs. Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) was pooled via a three-level random-effects model with restricted maximum likelihood estimation and Knapp-Hartung correction; heterogeneity was explored through multivariable meta-regression. Bias and reporting quality were assessed using QUADAS-3 and METRICS, respectively. Ten studies (2019-2025) encompassing 5409 patients, 7057 aneurysms, and 62 models were included. Pooled AUC was 0.793 (95% CI 0.754-0.827), with sensitivity of 0.713 and specificity of 0.780. Conventional ML achieved the highest AUC (0.827), followed by statistical models (0.779) and DL (0.741). Meta-regression explained 76.2% of variance; statistical model family was the sole significant predictor of inferior performance (p = 0.002). Nine of ten studies carried high risk of bias. No publication bias was detected (p = 0.186). AI-based models, particularly conventional ML ensemble architectures, demonstrate moderate-to-good discriminative accuracy for small UIA rupture risk stratification, meaningfully surpassing conventional scoring tools. Multicenter prospective registries, pre-rupture imaging protocols, and explainable AI frameworks are essential to support transparent neurosurgical decision-making.
zh_abstract: [医学影像信息学杂志] 小型未破裂颅内动脉瘤（UIA；≤ 7 mm）总体上具有显著的破裂风险，但传统评分工具（PHASES、ELAPSS）在该亚组中的表现接近随机水平。本系统评价和荟萃分析评估了基于人工智能的模型预测小型 UIA 破裂风险的合并诊断准确性，并比较了不同算法架构的表现。本研究已在 PROSPERO 前瞻性注册（CRD420251142915），并按照 PRISMA-DTA/PRISMA-S 标准开展。于 2025 年 10 月检索 MEDLINE、Scopus 和 Web of Science，并于 2026 年 6 月更新检索。纳入的研究须将机器学习（ML）、深度学习（DL）、影像组学或整合计算流体动力学的模型应用于小型 UIA。采用三层随机效应模型，结合限制性最大似然估计和 Knapp-Hartung 校正，合并受试者操作特征曲线下面积（AUC）；通过多变量元回归探讨异质性。分别采用 QUADAS-3 和 METRICS 评估偏倚和报告质量。共纳入 10 项研究（2019–2025 年），涉及 5409 例患者、7057 个动脉瘤和 62 个模型。合并 AUC 为 0.793（95% CI 0.754–0.827），敏感性为 0.713，特异性为 0.780。传统机器学习的 AUC 最高（0.827），其次为统计模型（0.779）和深度学习（0.741）。元回归解释了 76.2% 的方差；统计模型类别是表现较差的唯一显著预测因素（p = 0.002）。十项研究中有九项存在高偏倚风险。未检测到发表偏倚（p = 0.186）。基于人工智能的模型，尤其是传统机器学习集成架构，在小型 UIA 破裂风险分层方面显示出中等至良好的区分准确性，明显优于传统评分工具。多中心前瞻性登记研究、破裂前影像学方案以及可解释人工智能框架，对于支持透明的神经外科决策至关重要。

title: Beyond a single ratio: an adaptable deep learning approach to analyze the prognostic value of TSP distribution in ovarian cancer.
zh_title: 超越单一比值：用可适配深度学习分析卵巢癌肿瘤间质比分布的预后价值
summary: 提出少样本微调的深度学习流程，量化全肿瘤范围的肿瘤-间质比分布以反映空间异质性并评估预后。

量化整张切片TSP分布而非单一值
用于卵巢癌预后价值分析

abstract: [The Journal of pathology] The tumor-stroma percentage (TSP) has been proposed as a prognostic factor in ovarian cancer. When assessed manually by pathologists, the TSP can be subject to significant inter-rater variability. Automated methods for TSP determination have recently been developed. Existing approaches typically yield a single TSP value for a relatively small region of interest in the slide, introducing bias through region selection and potentially overlooking the TSP distribution across the entire histologically examined area. We present an adaptable deep learning pipeline, efficiently fine-tuned for ovarian cancer tissue analysis using a few-shot learning approach, requiring only minimal new training annotations. Instead of calculating a single TSP value, our method quantifies the global TSP distribution across the entire tumor and therefore captures its spatial heterogeneity. To identify a prognostic biomarker, we systematically evaluated a panel of metrics describing this distribution in 98 patients. Our analysis revealed that the mean-median difference of the TSP distribution [hazard ratio (HR) = 0.60, 95% CI = 0.46-0.79, p < 0.001], a quantitative measure of asymmetry, together with the mean TSP (HR = 0.65, 95% CI = 0.43-0.97, p = 0.03), are biomarkers significantly associated with recurrence-free survival. By successfully adapting a pipeline for ovarian cancer, we demonstrate that automated analysis of the entire TSP distribution provides significant prognostic information superior to that obtained by manual assessment. Spatial heterogeneity of the TSP is a key prognostic factor. © 2026 Fraunhofer IIS and The Author(s). title: Fu-TCM: a multimodal large language model that learns traditional Chinese medicine diagnostic reasoning
zh_title: Fu-TCM：学习中医诊断推理的多模态大模型
summary: Fu-TCM基于约712万条中医相关数据训练，并用辨证导向的BGPO优化，其27B版本在六项中医基准中领先。
key_points: 数据来自古籍、教材、医学图像、病例等
提出BGPO奖励辨证推理与证型预测
Fu-TCM-27B在六项基准领先
reason: 领域多模态大模型方法有新意，预印本，临床验证有限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are advancing in multimodal understanding and reasoning, accelerating medical model development. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) uses evidence from the four examinations to determine disease location and nature, differentiate syndromes and guide treatment. This diagnostic process constitutes a complete chain of reasoning. We present Fu-TCM, a multimodal TCM LLM trained on data retained after cleaning and filtering an initial collection of approximately 7.12 million examples derived from classical texts, textbooks, medical images, clinical cases and publicly available datasets. The model was further optimized using Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization (BGPO), which explicitly targets syndrome differentiation through rewards for response format, intermediate TCM reasoning fields and final syndrome predictions. Fu-TCM-27B led all six benchmarks spanning TCM reasoning, text and vision, achieving a macro-average accuracy of 81.01% and surpassing the strongest reference model with complete results across all six benchmarks by 7.13 percentage points. Its largest margin was 11.90 points on Fu-bianzheng. Case-level analyses further showed a positive association between intermediate-field accuracy and final syndrome-selection accuracy in most evaluated models. These findings suggest that TCM syndrome differentiation may be computationally learnable and that structured reasoning supervision can improve performance across TCM tasks.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在多模态理解与推理方面不断进步，加速了医学模型的开发。中医（TCM）通过四诊所得依据来判断病位与病性、辨别证候并指导治疗，这一诊断过程构成了一条完整的推理链。我们提出了Fu-TCM，这是一种多模态中医大语言模型，其训练数据来自对最初收集的约712万条样本进行清洗和筛选后保留的数据，这些样本源自古籍、教材、医学图像、临床病例及公开数据集。该模型进一步采用辨证引导策略优化（Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization，BGPO）进行优化，该方法通过对回答格式、中医中间推理字段和最终证候预测设置奖励，明确针对辨证进行优化。Fu-TCM-27B在涵盖中医推理、文本和视觉的全部六项基准测试中均居首位，宏平均准确率为81.01%，比在全部六项基准上均有完整结果的最强对照模型高出7.13个百分点。其最大优势出现在Fu-bianzheng上，领先11.90个百分点。病例层面的分析进一步显示，在大多数被评估模型中，中间字段准确率与最终证候选择准确率之间呈正相关。这些发现提示，中医辨证可能在计算上是可学习的，且结构化推理监督可以提升各类中医任务的表现。

title: Disparity Laundering: Consensus Without Fairness in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
zh_title: 差异洗白：临床多智能体系统中的共识而非公平
summary: 在120例MIMIC-IV急诊病例上测试5种模型族与4种聚合拓扑，发现多智能体协商未消除、仅转移了人口学分诊偏差。
key_points: 20种配置均使黑人患者获更高急性分诊
公平提示与人口信息遮蔽无效
自我去偏反而扩大差距
reason: 设计系统的预印本，涉及临床多智能体公平，但仅回顾性数据
abstract: Clinical large language models are increasingly fielded as multi-agent teams, on the assumption that deliberation averages out individual error. It does not average out bias. Across a full factorial of five model families and four aggregation topologies on 120 real MIMIC-IV emergency cases under counterfactual demographic swaps, no configuration neutralizes the disparity: all 20 cells commit the direction of their agents' independent answers, giving Black patients more acute triage. Every model has a topology that amplifies its baseline gap, but which one varies by model, so no design is reliably safe or reliably amplifying: the disparity is relocated, never removed. Late-stage fixes fail: fairness instructions and demographic masking leave the gap untouched, and per-agent self-debiasing widens it, because the bias is already encoded in the agents' ordinary clinical numbers. We call this disparity laundering; the audits now applied to clinical AI, per model, per output, per version, can certify the parts but never the committed decision. Interventions close the gap exactly when they make counterfactual versions visible inside the system and pool them, through deliberation, into the committed decision. A diverse-perspective ensemble does both while keeping the team, with no retraining or architectural change: the disparity falls by 67 to 94% where all five perspectives pool at every round, and the one topology that never pools them is the one it cannot reliably repair. Medical multi-agent systems do not filter demographic bias; they launder it into plausible decisions no single-version audit can catch, and the only defense is to make the bias visible.
zh_abstract: 临床大语言模型越来越多地以多智能体团队的形式部署，其假设是协商讨论可以平均掉个体误差。但它并不能平均掉偏倚。在对 120 例真实 MIMIC-IV 急诊病例进行反事实人口学替换的条件下，我们对五个模型家族和四种聚合拓扑结构进行了完整的析因设计，结果没有任何配置能消除这种差异：全部 20 个单元都延续了其各智能体独立回答的方向，即对黑人患者给出更紧急的分诊。每个模型都存在一种会放大其基线差距的拓扑结构，但具体是哪一种因模型而异，因此没有任何设计是可靠安全或可靠放大的：差异只是被转移，从未被消除。后期修正措施无效：公平性指令和人口学信息遮蔽对差距毫无影响，而针对单个智能体的自我去偏倚反而使差距扩大，因为偏倚已经编码在智能体的常规临床数值之中。我们将这种现象称为“差异洗白”（disparity laundering）；目前应用于临床 AI 的审计，无论是按模型、按输出还是按版本进行，都只能认证各个组成部分，而无法认证最终做出的决策。当干预措施使反事实版本在系统内部可见，并通过协商将其汇集到最终决策中时，才能恰好缩小差距。多元视角集成方法在保留团队的同时实现了这两点，且无需重新训练或更改架构：在所有五种视角于每一轮都汇集的情况下，差异下降了 67% 至 94%，而唯一从不汇集它们的拓扑结构，也是该方法无法可靠修复的那一种。医学多智能体系统不会过滤人口学偏倚；它们会将偏倚洗白为看似合理的决策，而任何单一版本的审计都无法发现，唯一的防御办法是使偏倚可见。

title: Visually Irrelevant Hallucinations in Medical Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 医学视觉语言模型中的视觉无关幻觉
summary: 提出CLEAR框架，通过局部反事实干预在短语层面估计医学VLM生成内容的幻觉风险。
key_points: 关注报告生成与医学VQA中的幻觉
将回答分解为可视觉评估的短语
对定位区域做局部反事实扰动
reason: 医学VLM幻觉评估的新方法预印本；命中多模态偏好
abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) show strong performance in radiology report generation (RRG) and medical visual question answering (Med-VQA), producing free-form clinical descriptions and answers from medical images. However, they may generate clinically meaningful statements that lack visual evidence or contradict image content. We refer to these errors as visually irrelevant hallucinations and investigate them at the phrase level. We propose CLEAR (Counterfactual Localized Evaluation of Alignment and Response), a model-agnostic post-hoc framework for phrase-level hallucination risk estimation. CLEAR decomposes generated responses into visually assessable clinical phrases. For each phrase, phrase-conditioned grounding identifies a candidate visual region, which is selectively perturbed by a localized counterfactual intervention. CLEAR characterizes the intervention using two complementary auditing cues: response cues, capturing semantic and clinically meaningful changes in the generated response, and alignment cues, measuring changes in image-phrase compatibility. These cues are normalized and jointly modeled to estimate phrase-level hallucination risk. Across four datasets spanning RRG and Med-VQA, CLEAR outperforms state-of-the-art hallucination detection baselines across multiple medical and general-purpose VLMs. On MIMIC-CXR, CLEAR improves AUPRC from 85.10% to 90.23%. Its effectiveness is further validated on a GT-derived controlled VIH benchmark. These results establish visually irrelevant hallucination as an important fine-grained reliability failure mode in medical VLMs and demonstrate the value of model-agnostic visual-support auditing for more trustworthy multimodal clinical generation.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）在放射学报告生成（RRG）和医学视觉问答（Med-VQA）中表现出色，能够根据医学图像生成自由形式的临床描述和回答。然而，它们可能生成具有临床意义但缺乏视觉证据或与图像内容相矛盾的陈述。我们将这类错误称为视觉无关幻觉，并在短语层面对其进行研究。我们提出了CLEAR（Counterfactual Localized Evaluation of Alignment and Response，对齐与响应的反事实局部评估），这是一种与模型无关的事后框架，用于短语级幻觉风险估计。CLEAR将生成的回答分解为可进行视觉评估的临床短语。对于每个短语，基于短语条件的定位（grounding）确定一个候选视觉区域，并通过局部反事实干预对其进行选择性扰动。CLEAR利用两类互补的审核线索来刻画该干预：响应线索，用于捕捉生成回答中语义上和临床意义上的变化；以及对齐线索，用于衡量图像-短语相容性的变化。这些线索经过归一化并联合建模，以估计短语级幻觉风险。在涵盖RRG和Med-VQA的四个数据集上，CLEAR在多种医学及通用VLM上均优于最先进的幻觉检测基线。在MIMIC-CXR上，CLEAR将AUPRC从85.10%提高到90.23%。其有效性还在一个源自GT（真值）的受控VIH基准上得到进一步验证。这些结果确立了视觉无关幻觉是医学VLM中一种重要的细粒度可靠性失效模式，并证明了与模型无关的视觉支持审核对于实现更可信的多模态临床生成的价值。

title: PulmoWorld: An Asynchronous Multimodal Medical World Model for Longitudinal Pneumonia Dynamics
zh_title: PulmoWorld：面向肺炎纵向动态的异步多模态医学世界模型
summary: 提出用于肺炎纵向动态的世界模型，处理异步、不完整观测，支持递归预测与受风险约束的规划，在MASS肺炎队列上评估。
key_points: 历史感知滤波，仅在观测到时更新信念
递归预测临床值、模态表征与预后
Cap-MBRL在授权动作集内受风险预算规划
reason: 医学世界模型新方法预印本，有基线对比，证据有限；偏好上调
abstract: Pneumonia changes across respiration, inflammation, and organ function, while the measurements that describe it arrive at different times and are often incomplete. We introduce PULMOWORLD, a world model for longitudinal pneumonia dynamics that connects asynchronous state estimation, recursive simulation, and evidence-constrained planning. History-aware filtering separates state propagation from observation-driven correction, so a measurement updates the shared belief only when it is observed. That belief supports recursive forecasts of clinical values and modality representations, and summaries of future prognosis. Cap-MBRL searches imagined continuations inside an authorized action set and replaces a frozen fallback only when a candidate meets the risk budget and a predicted-cost margin. On the pneumonia cohort MASS, recursive forecasts are competitive with task-trained sequence models, and simulated future states retain prognostic information. Trained separately on public MIMIC-IV-CXR chest radiographs and clinical trajectories, this model improves prognostic discrimination over latest-value fusion in development and is competitive on long-horizon error on the locked pneumonia panel. In five known-mechanism MASS-Syn environments, Cap-MBRL lowers selection regret relative to direct fallback execution.

title: Knowledge-structured and evidence-aware semantic self-distillation for glomerular pathology foundation model
zh_title: 面向肾小球病理基础模型的知识结构化语义自蒸馏
summary: 提出GloSAGE框架，利用预训练视觉教师预测的病灶谱构建结构化病理描述，通过图文对齐支持肾小球零样本病灶识别等任务（预印本，未经同行评审）。
key_points: 以视觉教师病灶谱合成结构化文本，免去昂贵图文配对
可靠性筛选锚点，并构建证据引导的负样本对
基于GloMillion开发，在七个肾小球/病例级队列评估
reason: 病理基础模型新方法，多队列评估，但为预印本且摘要信息有限；病理方向上调
abstract: Visual foundation models learn rich pathological morphology but lack explicit concept-level supervision. Vision--language pretraining can provide this supervision but requires costly image--text pairs. Here, we introduce GloSAGE, a semantic self-distillation framework that uses lesion profiles predicted by a pretrained visual teacher to construct structured pathology descriptions. Reliability-guided selection identifies image--text anchors, while Knowledge-Structured Pathology Text Synthesis and Evidence-Guided Negative-pair Construction account for partially observed lesions. Image--text alignment trains projection layers while retaining the frozen visual encoder; an intermediate Semantic Transfer Layer supplies features for downstream tasks. Developed on GloMillion and evaluated across seven glomerulus- and case-level cohorts, GloSAGE supported zero-shot lesion recognition, image--text retrieval, hard-negative discrimination and concept-intervention analyses. It outperformed its source visual model in most lesion-recognition tasks and improved lesion grading, while supporting competitive case-level disease classification, injury grading and baseline renal function estimation. Ablations supported the combined contributions of knowledge-structured text and evidence-guided negatives, and the intermediate transfer layer improved mean lesion-recognition ROC-AUC relative to the complete projection output. A frozen language model conditioned on GloSAGE features generated glomerular descriptions. These findings suggest that teacher-derived lesion profiles can provide annotation-efficient semantic supervision for extending a glomerular visual foundation model.
zh_abstract: 视觉基础模型能够学习丰富的病理形态，但缺乏明确的概念层面监督。视觉-语言预训练可以提供这种监督，但需要代价高昂的图像-文本配对数据。在此，我们提出 GloSAGE，一种语义自蒸馏框架，利用预训练视觉教师模型预测的病变特征谱构建结构化的病理描述。基于可靠性的筛选用于确定图像-文本锚点，而知识结构化病理文本合成（Knowledge-Structured Pathology Text Synthesis）和证据引导的负样本对构建（Evidence-Guided Negative-pair Construction）则用于处理仅部分被观察到的病变。图像-文本对齐训练投影层，同时保持视觉编码器冻结；中间的语义迁移层（Semantic Transfer Layer）为下游任务提供特征。GloSAGE 在 GloMillion 上开发，并在七个肾小球级和病例级队列中进行评估，支持零样本病变识别、图像-文本检索、困难负样本判别和概念干预分析。在大多数病变识别任务中，其表现优于其源视觉模型，并改善了病变分级，同时在病例级疾病分类、损伤分级和基线肾功能估计方面具有竞争力。消融实验支持知识结构化文本与证据引导负样本的联合贡献，且相较于完整的投影输出，中间迁移层提高了平均病变识别 ROC-AUC。以 GloSAGE 特征为条件的冻结语言模型可生成肾小球描述。这些结果表明，源自教师模型的病变特征谱可为扩展肾小球视觉基础模型提供标注高效的语义监督。

title: Performance of a foundation model to generate thousands of predicted outcomes across multiple use cases
zh_title: PhenOM基础模型：跨多场景生成数千种预测结局
summary: PhenOM是基于OM1数据云逾4亿患者纵向医疗事件数据训练的生成式基础模型，可预测多种诊断与临床结局，时间跨度最长5年。
key_points: 训练数据来自逾4亿患者记录
单一架构覆盖多种诊断、事件与结局
预测时间窗最长5年
reason: 患者级纵向基础模型、规模大；预印本且摘要缺结果，适度上调
abstract: Background. Predictive artificial intelligence (AI) models hold great promise for medical care. While many types of models have proliferated across healthcare and the life sciences, systematic, rapid generation of multi-condition predictions of diagnoses, future medical events and future clinical outcomes from a single foundation-model architecture remains rare. PhenOM(R) is a generative AI foundation model trained and validated on longitudinal medical-event data from more than 400 million patient records in the OM1 Real World Data Cloud (RWDC) and designed to complete predictive tasks for a broad array of medical diagnoses, events and clinical outcomes (collectively outcomes) at varying time intervals, currently up to five (5) years. This paper describes the implementation of PhenOM to complete a vast number of predictive tasks across clinical domains and outcomes. Methods. PhenOM was evaluated across four outcome categories (Future Risk, Screening, Care Opportunity, and Treatment Effect) in multiple domains spanning chronic disease, acute medical events, healthcare utilization, and rare and frequently undiagnosed conditions. Performance was assessed using area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). Outcomes were defined within an eligible-population framework using standardized medical code sets (ICD-10, SNOMED, CPT, NDC, LOINC) unless outcomes could not be specified with an existing code. All benchmarks reported were derived from data excluded from training. Results. As of this publication, the single PhenOM model has been used to complete and validate thousands of predictive tasks covering more than 1,770 outcomes spanning most organ systems and clinical specialties, with new predictive tasks being validated each day. Overall, 80 percent of predictive tasks achieved AUROC of at least 0.70 and 30 percent achieved AUROC of at least 0.80. We present a sample of 177 of these tasks as examples that show the breadth of tasks the model can complete. Performance varied systematically by outcome and clinical domain. Conclusions. PhenOM demonstrates the ability to complete thousands of predictive tasks across clinical domains and outcomes at the individual patient level, without additional training. Outcomes include screening for undiagnosed conditions, predicting future conditions, medical events, effects of treatments, and assessing care opportunities. title: Agentic Discovery Transfer Enables Cross-Cancer Discovery at Scale
zh_title: 智能体发现迁移：跨癌种大规模发现
summary: 提出多智能体LLM框架SMART，将已发表研究结论迁移到目标scRNA-seq数据中检验，应用于6种癌症的121项研究（预印本，未经同行评审）。
key_points: 定义“发现迁移”任务并提出SMART框架
自动提取结论、生成并执行分析、报告可迁移性
发现肺癌预后特征在肝癌、胰腺癌、胸膜间皮瘤中与生存相关
reason: 预印本，AI用于生物医学发现的新方法，规模较大但证据有限
abstract: Cancer research generates tens of thousands of studies each year, yet whether a published finding holds in another cancer type or patient population is rarely tested, because doing so is labor-intensive and difficult to scale. We define this task as discovery transfer and present SMART, a multi-agent large language model framework for discovery transfer in single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) studies. Given a source manuscript and a target scRNA-seq dataset, SMART extracts major clinical and mechanistic findings, generates and executes analyses for the testable findings, and reports which findings transfer and suggests follow-up. Applied to 121 studies across six cancer types, SMART identified findings that transfer across cancers, including a lung cancer prognostic signature that we confirmed to be associated with survival in liver cancer, pancreatic cancer and pleural mesothelioma. SMART also generated new mechanistic hypotheses, demonstrating how agentic discovery transfer can extend published findings beyond their original setting.
zh_abstract: 癌症研究每年产生数以万计的研究成果，但已发表的发现在另一种癌症类型或患者人群中是否成立却很少得到检验，因为这样做需要大量人力且难以规模化。我们将这一任务定义为发现迁移（discovery transfer），并提出 SMART，这是一种面向单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）研究中发现迁移的多智能体大语言模型框架。给定一篇源论文和一个目标 scRNA-seq 数据集，SMART 会提取主要的临床和机制性发现，针对可检验的发现生成并执行分析，报告哪些发现可以迁移，并提出后续建议。将 SMART 应用于六种癌症类型的 121 项研究后，其识别出了可跨癌症迁移的发现，包括一个肺癌预后特征，我们证实该特征与肝癌、胰腺癌和胸膜间皮瘤的生存相关。SMART 还产生了新的机制假说，表明智能体式发现迁移可以将已发表的发现扩展到其原始情境之外。

title: Multi-modal data Integration for Metastatic Risk Prediction of AJCC Stage I/II Melanomas: Results from the Population-based Dutch Early-stage Melanoma Study (D-ESMEL)
zh_title: 多模态数据整合预测I/II期黑色素瘤转移风险：D-ESMEL研究
summary: 基于荷兰人群D-ESMEL队列，整合临床病理、基因组、转录组与病理组学数据，评估多种整合策略预测早期黑色素瘤转移。
key_points: 发现集221组病例对照，验证集154组
整合临床病理、基因组、转录组、病理组学
比较四种多模态整合策略
reason: 转移预测多模态，有独立验证队列但样本不大，预印本
abstract: Early-stage melanoma accounts for 40-60% of melanoma-related deaths. Most prognostic modelling studies focus on unimodal approaches or a single multimodal integration strategy, overlooking alternative methods and biological processes underlying metastatic progression. We aimed to evaluate multi-modal data integration for predicting metastasis using the Dutch Early-Stage Melanoma (D-ESMEL) study, the world's largest multi-modal cohort of American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) stage I/II melanoma. We analysed clinicopathological, genomic, transcriptomic, and pathomics data from the D-ESMEL study. The discovery set included 221 case-control sets matched on follow-up time, age, sex, Breslow thickness, and ulceration. The validation cohort included 154 AJCC stage matched case-control sets based on a population of >5,500 stage I/II melanoma patients. We evaluated four integration strategies (early, intermediate, mixed, and late) using a repeated (n=5) nested 3-fold cross-validation in the discovery set. The best-performing models were evaluated in the validation cohort using the odds ratios (ORs) and a weighted C-index reflecting performance in the sampled population. In the discovery set, intermediate integration of genomics and transcriptomics achieved the highest balanced accuracy (mean: 0.62; 95% CI: 0.57-0.66). Early and late integration of transcriptomics and pathomics, and the unimodal transcriptomics model showed similar performance (mean: 0.61; 95% CI: 0.58-0.65). In the validation cohort both early integration, late integration, and the unimodal transcriptomics model achieved the highest balanced accuracy of 0.60. When adjusted for clinicopathological risk factors early integration remained an independent prognostic factor for metastasis (OR 1.75; p<0.01), outperforming transcriptomics alone (OR 1.26; p<0.01). Early integration reached a weighted C-index of 0.83 outperforming AJCC stage (0.81 C-index). When combined the population-weighted C-index was significantly improved to 0.85 (p<0.01). Early integration of transcriptomics and pathomics outperformed all unimodal models and improved prediction of distant metastasis independently of AJCC stage. Understanding the biological mechanisms underlying these predictions may further support clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: 早期黑色素瘤占黑色素瘤相关死亡的 40–60%。大多数预后建模研究集中于单模态方法或单一的多模态整合策略，忽视了其他方法以及转移进展背后的生物学过程。我们旨在利用荷兰早期黑色素瘤（D-ESMEL）研究（全球最大的美国癌症联合委员会［AJCC］I/II 期黑色素瘤多模态队列）评估多模态数据整合在预测转移方面的价值。我们分析了 D-ESMEL 研究中的临床病理、基因组、转录组和病理组学数据。发现集包含 221 个病例-对照组，按随访时间、年龄、性别、Breslow 厚度和溃疡进行匹配。验证队列包含 154 个按 AJCC 分期匹配的病例-对照组，来源于 >5,500 例 I/II 期黑色素瘤患者人群。我们在发现集中采用重复（n=5）嵌套 3 折交叉验证评估了四种整合策略（早期、中期、混合和晚期）。表现最佳的模型在验证队列中以比值比（OR）和反映抽样人群表现的加权 C 指数进行评估。在发现集中，基因组和转录组的中期整合获得了最高的平衡准确率（均值：0.62；95% CI：0.57–0.66）。转录组与病理组学的早期和晚期整合以及单模态转录组模型表现相近（均值：0.61；95% CI：0.58–0.65）。在验证队列中，早期整合、晚期整合和单模态转录组模型均获得了最高的平衡准确率 0.60。在校正临床病理危险因素后，早期整合仍是转移的独立预后因素（OR 1.75；p<0.01），优于单独的转录组（OR 1.26；p<0.01）。早期整合的加权 C 指数达到 0.83，优于 AJCC 分期（C 指数 0.81）。二者联合时，人群加权 C 指数显著提高至 0.85（p<0.01）。转录组与病理组学的早期整合优于所有单模态模型，并且独立于 AJCC 分期改善了远处转移的预测。了解这些预测背后的生物学机制可能进一步支持临床决策。

title: QUARTZ: Cross-Dataset Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Retinal Vasculometry
zh_title: QUARTZ：跨数据集的AI视网膜血管测量系统
summary: QUARTZ用于处理英国NHS超400万张视网膜图像的大规模血管形态分析，并利用26个标注数据集提升跨数据集泛化能力。
key_points: 面向流行病学研究的自动化视网膜血管测量
可处理部分照明等较低质量图像
整合26个标注数据集覆盖多种人群与相机
reason: 预印本，眼科影像，大规模数据与跨数据集泛化，但摘要缺少验证细节
abstract: Examination of retinal images provides a non-invasive means to assess the body's microvascular system, with vessel morphology linked to ocular and systemic diseases. QUARTZ (QUantitative Analysis of Retinal vessel Topology and siZe) is an automated, artificial intelligence-enabled retinal vasculometry system designed for processing large-scale retinal image datasets, including over 4 million images from within the National Health Service, to facilitate epidemiological studies. The system is uniquely capable of extracting useful information from lower quality images, including those which are partially illuminated, enabling analysis of a greater proportion of images. To enhance cross-dataset generalisation of the system from an earlier dataset-tailored approach, this work leverages 26 annotated retinal image datasets spanning diverse demographics, diseases, camera types, and imaging protocols. Evaluation on the external EPIC-Norfolk dataset demonstrates robust performance with F1 scores of 0.8305, 0.8477, 0.8741, 0.9532, and 0.8677 for arteriole, venule, vessel, optic disc, and optic cup segmentation, respectively, and 0.9197 for image quality classification. The cross-dataset generalisation approach demonstrated increased performance for arteriole/venule segmentation and optic disc segmentation. However, improvements in performance were not observed for optic cup segmentation, or for image quality classification. An online tool is provided to support wider adoption and reproducible biomarker research across diverse populations and imaging settings. In addition, the new public CHASE-AV database is introduced for arteriole and venule segmentation.
zh_abstract: 检查视网膜图像为评估人体微血管系统提供了一种无创手段，血管形态与眼部及全身性疾病相关。QUARTZ（视网膜血管拓扑和大小的定量分析，QUantitative Analysis of Retinal vessel Topology and siZe）是一种自动化、基于人工智能的视网膜血管测量系统，旨在处理大规模视网膜图像数据集（包括来自英国国家医疗服务体系内的400多万张图像），以促进流行病学研究。该系统具有从低质量图像（包括部分照明的图像）中提取有用信息的独特能力，从而可分析更大比例的图像。为了在早期针对特定数据集的方法基础上增强系统的跨数据集泛化能力，本工作利用了26个带注释的视网膜图像数据集，这些数据集涵盖不同的人口统计学特征、疾病、相机类型和成像方案。在外部EPIC-Norfolk数据集上的评估显示出稳健的性能：小动脉、小静脉、血管、视盘和视杯分割的F1分数分别为0.8305、0.8477、0.8741、0.9532和0.8677，图像质量分类的F1分数为0.9197。该跨数据集泛化方法使小动脉/小静脉分割和视盘分割的性能有所提高。然而，视杯分割和图像质量分类的性能未见改善。本文提供了一个在线工具，以支持在不同人群和成像环境中更广泛的采用及可重复的生物标志物研究。此外，还介绍了用于小动脉和小静脉分割的新公共数据库CHASE-AV。

title: An Adversarial Deep Learning Framework for Non-Rigid Brain MRI Registration in Brain Shift Compensation.
source: PubMed · Journal of neuroradiology = Journal de neuroradiologie
zh_title: 用于脑移位补偿的对抗式深度学习非刚性脑MRI配准框架
summary: 提出双向无监督3D配准框架，通过双向图像转换与形变场预测，无需配对数据估计术前与术中MRI的稠密形变场。
key_points: 双图像翻译通路加形变场预测器
双向一致性约束保证解剖对应
无需配对训练数据
reason: 同行评审配准方法，摘要未见外部验证或临床结局，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of neuroradiology = Journal de neuroradiologie] Accurate compensation for intra-operative brain shift remains a fundamental challenge in neurosurgical procedures, as misalignment between pre-operative and intra-operative images can lead to suboptimal surgical guidance. In this work, we propose a bidirectional, unsupervised 3D brain shift compensation framework for non-rigid MRI registration, designed to directly estimate dense deformation fields between pre-operative and intra-operative volumes. The proposed approach employs dual image-translation pathways coupled with a dedicated deformation field predictor, enabling robust alignment without requiring paired training data. A key component of the framework is the integration of bidirectional consistency constraints to enforce anatomical correspondence across domains, while deformation field estimation is explicitly optimized for registration accuracy. In addition, we incorporate a Haar wavelet-based perceptual similarity (HaarPSI) loss to improve the preservation of fine-scale anatomical structures during registration. The proposed method is evaluated against classical and state-of-the-art baselines, including Elastix, Voxelmorph, and several adversarial and GAN-based learning approaches adapted with comparable registration modules. Qualitative analyses of deformation fields and error maps further demonstrate improved alignment in regions most affected by brain shift. These results highlight the effectiveness of bidirectional deformation modeling combined with adversarial and perceptual constraints for accurate, physically plausible, and unsupervised 3D non-rigid registration in neurosurgical applications.
zh_abstract: [Journal of neuroradiology = Journal de neuroradiologie] 准确补偿术中脑移位仍是神经外科手术中的一项根本性挑战，因为术前与术中图像之间的错位可能导致手术引导欠佳。在本研究中，我们提出了一种用于非刚性 MRI 配准的双向、无监督三维脑移位补偿框架，旨在直接估计术前与术中体数据之间的稠密形变场。所提方法采用双图像转换通路并结合专用的形变场预测器，无需配对训练数据即可实现稳健的对齐。该框架的一个关键组成部分是引入双向一致性约束，以强化跨域的解剖对应关系，同时形变场估计针对配准精度进行了显式优化。此外，我们引入了基于 Haar 小波的感知相似性（HaarPSI）损失，以在配准过程中更好地保留精细尺度的解剖结构。我们将所提方法与经典及最先进的基线方法进行了比较，包括 Elastix、Voxelmorph，以及若干配备可比配准模块的对抗式和基于 GAN 的学习方法。对形变场和误差图的定性分析进一步表明，在受脑移位影响最大的区域，对齐效果得到改善。这些结果凸显了双向形变建模结合对抗和感知约束，对于神经外科应用中准确、物理上合理的无监督三维非刚性配准的有效性。

title: A 211K Parameter Foundation Model: Genetic Prompting in Neural Cellular Automata
zh_title: 211K参数基础模型：神经元胞自动机中的遗传提示
summary: 提出基于神经元胞自动机的轻量级医学分割基础模型Foundational-NCA，通过遗传提示无需重训练适应多种分割任务。
key_points: 基于NCA，仅约21.1万参数
结合梯度学习与潜在任务空间遗传优化
面向低资源环境的医学分割
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，轻量基础模型，证据有限
abstract: The scale of modern foundation models enables broad task generalization. In medical imaging, where segmentation demands vary widely across clinical contexts, such flexibility is invaluable. But current models, such as SAM trade adaptability for scale, locking their utility behind high-end infrastructure and leaving behind the low-resource environments most in need of diagnostic support. To bridge this gap, we introduce Foundational-NCA, a lightweight foundation model capable of adapting to a wide range of medical segmentation tasks without retraining. Built on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), Foundational-NCA incorporates gradient-based learning with genetic optimization over a latent task space, using a compact task vector to guide predictions. This enables dynamic adaptation via a genetic prompt mechanism, allowing the model to generalize across tasks while keeping the parameter count magnitudes lower at just 211 thousand, compared to SAM-based models with 38.9 to 636 million parameters. We evaluate Foundational-NCA on 15 trained and 6 entirely unseen segmentation tasks from the TotalSegmentator dataset, achieving an average Dice score of 84.5% on known tasks and 60.4% on unseen ones. These results demonstrate that task generalization is possible in ultra-compact models, laying the groundwork for resource-efficient, deployable foundation models in clinical environments where infrastructure is limited. By reducing model size by over 180 times, Foundational-NCA takes a step toward a more equitable future for medical AI, one where powerful tools are within reach of every healthcare setting.
zh_abstract: 现代基础模型的规模使其能够广泛泛化到各类任务。在医学影像中，不同临床情境对分割的需求差异很大，这种灵活性尤为宝贵。但是，诸如 SAM 之类的现有模型以适应性换取规模，其应用依赖高端基础设施，使最需要诊断支持的低资源环境无法使用。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 Foundational-NCA，这是一种轻量级基础模型，无需重新训练即可适应多种医学分割任务。Foundational-NCA 以神经细胞自动机（Neural Cellular Automata，NCA）为基础，将基于梯度的学习与潜在任务空间上的遗传优化相结合，并使用紧凑的任务向量引导预测。这使模型能够通过遗传提示机制进行动态适应，从而在多种任务间实现泛化，同时参数量仅为 21.1 万，比参数量为 3890 万至 6.36 亿的基于 SAM 的模型低几个数量级。我们在 TotalSegmentator 数据集的 15 个已训练分割任务和 6 个完全未见过的分割任务上评估了 Foundational-NCA，在已知任务上平均 Dice 分数为 84.5%，在未见任务上为 60.4%。这些结果表明，超紧凑模型也可以实现任务泛化，为在基础设施有限的临床环境中部署资源高效的基础模型奠定了基础。通过将模型规模缩小 180 倍以上，Foundational-NCA 朝着更公平的医疗人工智能未来迈出了一步，使每一种医疗场景都能用上强大的工具。

title: Learning Scientific Trajectories to Predict Future Biomedical Discoveries
zh_title: 学习科学轨迹以预测未来生物医学发现
summary: 提出ForeSCITE框架，利用约300万条已发表结论嵌入的时间方向生成假说，并做回顾性时间切片评估。
key_points: 对结论嵌入聚类并估计时间方向
嵌入语言模型把投影坐标解码为假说
407个聚类上做回顾性时间切片评估
reason: AI科学发现方向新方法预印本，证据有限；方向命中小幅上调
abstract: AI co-scientists have expanded the use of large language models for generating scientific hypotheses and guiding experimental investigation. Here we investigate whether temporal patterns in the semantic representations of complete biomedical conclusions can guide hypothesis generation. We introduce ForeSCITE, a framework that identifies thematic clusters of published conclusions, estimates a direction separating earlier from more recent findings within each cluster, and projects existing conclusion embeddings along these directions. An embedding language model trained to reconstruct conclusions decodes the projected coordinates into natural-language hypotheses. Across 407 clusters derived from approximately three million pre-cutoff conclusions, we identify temporal structure and illustrate its retention after decoding. In retrospective, time-sliced evaluations, ForeSCITE increases semantic coverage beyond the historical corpus, biomedical entity-pair novelty and post-cutoff pair re-observation relative to five prompt-based and retrieval-augmented baselines. Expert review of prioritized CAR-T hypotheses identified 37 candidates as both novel and biologically plausible, and expert justifications for five selected hypotheses illustrate their biological rationale and subsequent literature support where available. These findings support temporal guidance in semantic space as a scalable mechanism for proposing biomedical hypotheses for subsequent scientific evaluation.
zh_abstract: AI 协同科学家（AI co-scientists）扩展了大语言模型在生成科学假设和指导实验研究中的应用。本文探讨完整生物医学结论的语义表征中的时间模式能否指导假设生成。我们提出了 ForeSCITE 框架，该框架识别已发表结论的主题簇，在每个簇内估计区分较早与较新发现的方向，并将现有结论嵌入沿这些方向进行投影。一个经训练以重建结论的嵌入语言模型将投影后的坐标解码为自然语言假设。在由约三百万条截止日期之前的结论得到的 407 个簇中，我们识别出时间结构，并展示了其在解码后仍得以保留。在回顾性的时间切片评估中，相对于五种基于提示和检索增强的基线方法，ForeSCITE 提高了超出历史语料库的语义覆盖度、生物医学实体对的新颖性以及截止日期之后实体对的再次观察率。专家对优先排序的 CAR-T 假设进行评审，认定 37 个候选假设既新颖又具有生物学合理性；专家对所选五个假设给出的理由说明了其生物学依据，并在有文献时说明了后续文献支持。这些发现支持将语义空间中的时间引导作为一种可扩展机制，用于提出生物医学假设，以供后续科学评估。

title: Latent Decision Flow Rewards for Clinical Guideline Reasoning
zh_title: 面向临床指南推理的潜在决策流奖励
summary: 针对指南决策流监督中的路径-答案差距与路径多样性问题，提出新的奖励训练方法训练推理模型。
key_points: 指出路径-答案差距问题
指出同一决策可有多条有效路径
现有答案奖励、过程奖励、SFT各有局限
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，摘要未见充分结果；领域LLM小幅上调
abstract: Clinical practice guidelines encode evidence-based recommendations as conditional decision flows, which makes them a natural source of process supervision for training reasoning models. Two properties of clinical reasoning make this supervision difficult to use. A decision flow consistent with a guideline does not by itself determine the correct answer for a given patient, which we call the path--answer gap, and several valid decision flows can support the same clinical decision, which we call path multiplicity. Current training approaches address parts of this problem. Answer rewards supervise the final decision, and process rewards computed against a reference flow supervise one valid decision flow per case. Supervised fine-tuning on annotated flows teaches guideline-consistent reasoning but constrains the model to one trajectory per case and can reduce answer accuracy. We introduce GUIDER, a method that jointly optimizes a decision flow controller and a reasoning policy. The controller learns to generate plausible decision flows from guideline-derived supervision, and the policy learns to generate a decision flow and a final answer for each patient case. GUIDER computes the process reward for the policy over several controller-generated flows, which accounts for path multiplicity, and gates this reward on answer correctness, which addresses the path--answer gap. Joint training allows the process supervision to evolve with the policy. On MedGUIDE, GUIDER with Qwen3-14B achieves 82.5 weighted accuracy and 73.5 guideline adherence, 3.3 and 3.1 points above the strongest clinical reinforcement learning baseline. With Qwen3-14B and Gemma4-12B backbones, GUIDER also improves over CRPO, MRPO, and FaithMed on the out-of-domain benchmarks AMEGA-LLM, RealMedQA, and CancerGUIDE.
zh_abstract: 临床实践指南将循证推荐编码为条件性决策流程，这使其成为训练推理模型的天然过程监督来源。临床推理的两个特性使这种监督难以使用。其一，与指南一致的决策流程本身并不能决定特定患者的正确答案，我们称之为路径—答案差距（path--answer gap）；其二，多个有效的决策流程可以支持同一临床决策，我们称之为路径多样性（path multiplicity）。目前的训练方法只解决了该问题的部分方面。答案奖励监督最终决策，而依据参考流程计算的过程奖励则对每个病例监督一个有效的决策流程。基于标注流程的监督微调可教授与指南一致的推理，但会将模型限制在每个病例一条轨迹上，并可能降低答案准确率。我们提出了 GUIDER，一种联合优化决策流程控制器和推理策略的方法。控制器学习从源自指南的监督中生成合理的决策流程，策略则学习为每个患者病例生成决策流程和最终答案。GUIDER 针对多个由控制器生成的流程计算策略的过程奖励，以此考虑路径多样性，并将该奖励以答案正确性为门控，以此解决路径—答案差距。联合训练使过程监督能够随策略一同演化。在 MedGUIDE 上，采用 Qwen3-14B 的 GUIDER 取得 82.5 的加权准确率和 73.5 的指南依从性，分别比最强的临床强化学习基线高 3.3 和 3.1 分。使用 Qwen3-14B 和 Gemma4-12B 骨干网络时，GUIDER 在域外基准 AMEGA-LLM、RealMedQA 和 CancerGUIDE 上也优于 CRPO、MRPO 和 FaithMed。

title: AI/ML-enabled sepsis prediction systems: laboratory considerations from development to deployment.
zh_title: AI/ML脓毒症预测系统：从开发到部署的检验科考量
summary: 综述指出脓毒症预测算法依赖检验变量，平台更换、试剂变更等分析事件可能引起分布漂移，而检验科在开发与治理中长期缺位。
key_points: 检验变量是多数脓毒症AI的核心输入
试剂、平台、参考区间变化可致分布漂移
检验科在验证与治理中参与不足

abstract: [Journal of clinical microbiology] Sepsis prediction algorithms based on machine learning are increasingly embedded in electronic health record systems, and clinical laboratories have been largely absent from their development, validation, and governance. This is a consequential gap. Laboratory variables are central inputs to most deployed sepsis artificial intelligence (AI) tools, and routine analytical events such as platform transitions, reagent reformulations, and reference interval updates can shift the distributions of these inputs. Such distribution shifts are a recognized cause of degraded model performance; however, the effects of laboratory-specific changes remain insufficiently characterized for sepsis tools in clinical use. Neither clinical teams nor laboratories are currently well positioned to detect these effects. This review is written for clinical laboratorians who encounter these tools in practice or are asked to evaluate them for implementation. We describe the data sources used as model inputs and how analytical context, preanalytical variability, and ordering patterns influence model behavior. Five deployed algorithms with real-world implementation evidence are profiled alongside the broader preclinical landscape, including early warning systems, mortality and complication prediction models, and sepsis subtyping research. Development and implementation pitfalls are reviewed with attention to laboratory-specific considerations, and the regulatory and governance landscape is addressed with emphasis on where laboratorian involvement is most needed. Controlled outcomes data supporting currently deployed tools remain limited, and reported performance frequently does not replicate at external sites. Laboratorians bring expertise in analytical quality, data provenance, and change management that is not replicated elsewhere on implementation teams. As the field moves toward sepsis subtyping, continuous monitoring, and local model calibration, laboratorian expertise in analytical quality and monitoring will become increasingly central to how these tools are built, deployed, and maintained.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical microbiology] 基于机器学习的脓毒症预测算法越来越多地嵌入电子健康记录系统，而临床实验室在其开发、验证和管理中基本缺位。这是一个影响重大的缺口。实验室变量是大多数已部署的脓毒症人工智能（AI）工具的核心输入，而平台更换、试剂重新配方和参考区间更新等常规分析事件可能改变这些输入的分布。此类分布偏移是模型性能下降的公认原因；然而，对于临床使用中的脓毒症工具，实验室特异性变化的影响仍未得到充分描述。目前，临床团队和实验室都难以发现这些影响。本综述面向在实践中接触这些工具或被要求评估其实施的临床检验人员。我们描述了作为模型输入的数据来源，以及分析背景、分析前变异和医嘱模式如何影响模型行为。文中介绍了五种具有真实世界实施证据的已部署算法，并概述了更广泛的临床前研究格局，包括早期预警系统、死亡率和并发症预测模型以及脓毒症亚型研究。我们结合实验室特有的考量，回顾了开发和实施中的陷阱，并探讨了监管和治理格局，重点指出最需要检验人员参与之处。支持目前已部署工具的对照结局数据仍然有限，报告的性能在外部机构中常常无法重现。检验人员在分析质量、数据溯源和变更管理方面具备实施团队其他成员无法替代的专业能力。随着该领域向脓毒症亚型分型、持续监测和本地模型校准发展，检验人员在分析质量和监测方面的专业能力对这些工具的构建、部署和维护将变得日益核心。

title: Ambient AI scribes are here: What every PA needs to know before clicking "Sign".
source: PubMed · JAAPA : official journal of the American Academy of Physician Assistants

summary: 综述环境AI抄写员的早期证据：可能减少文书时间、改善医生福祉，但研究多为观察性、样本小、随访短，并存在幻觉等风险。
key_points: 早期证据提示减少文书时间并改善福祉
多数研究为观察性、小样本、短期
存在幻觉等新风险

abstract: [JAAPA : official journal of the American Academy of Physician Assistants] Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes, which record patient encounters and automatically draft clinical notes, are rapidly entering frontline practice. They rely on large language models to convert recorded conversations into structured documentation and are marketed as a way to reduce the documentation burden that contributes to clinician burnout. Early evidence from multicenter studies, randomized trials, systematic reviews, and international research suggests that ambient AI scribes may reduce documentation time and improve clinician well-being. However, most available studies are observational, reliant on small samples, and limited to short-term follow-up. At the same time, studies consistently raise concerns about new risks, including AI-generated "hallucinations" (fabricated content that appears confident), errors in draft notes (with omissions being the most common error type), documentation drift toward generic language, racial disparities in speech recognition accuracy, the use of unauthorized "shadow" AI tools with HIPAA and security implications, and unresolved questions about clinical safety outcomes. For physician associates (PAs), who are high-volume users of electronic health records and whose notes frequently serve as the primary communication channel with collaborating physicians, these risks carry particular weight. This review explains how ambient AI scribes work in accessible terms, synthesizes the current evidence base, and offers concrete strategies that PAs can use to ensure that these tools support safe, efficient, patient-centered practice.
zh_abstract: [JAAPA：美国医师助理学会官方期刊] 环境式人工智能（AI）抄录工具可记录患者就诊过程并自动起草临床病历，正在迅速进入一线临床实践。它们依赖大语言模型将录制的对话转换为结构化文档，并被宣传为减轻导致临床医生职业倦怠的文书负担的一种方式。来自多中心研究、随机试验、系统评价和国际研究的早期证据表明，环境式 AI 抄录工具可能减少文书记录时间并改善临床医生的幸福感。然而，现有研究大多为观察性研究，依赖小样本，且随访时间较短。与此同时，研究一致提出了对新风险的担忧，包括 AI 生成的“幻觉”（看似可信的虚构内容）、病历草稿中的错误（以遗漏为最常见的错误类型）、文书内容向泛化语言漂移、语音识别准确性方面的种族差异、使用未经授权的“影子”AI 工具所涉及的 HIPAA 和安全问题，以及临床安全性结局方面尚未解决的问题。对于医师助理（PA）而言，他们是电子健康记录的高频使用者，其病历常常是与合作医生之间的主要沟通渠道，这些风险尤为重要。本综述以通俗易懂的方式解释了环境式 AI 抄录工具的工作原理，综合了当前的证据基础，并提供了 PA 可用于确保这些工具支持安全、高效、以患者为中心的实践的具体策略。

title: From Target to Trial: Artificial Intelligence in Psychiatric Drug Development.
source: PubMed · Canadian journal of psychiatry. Revue canadienne de psychiatrie
zh_title: 从靶点到试验：AI在精神疾病药物研发中的应用
summary: 该社论概述AI如何在精神疾病药物研发各阶段发挥作用，包括靶点识别、分子设计、治疗反应预测及试验优化，并提及数字孪生与合成对照。
key_points: 精神疾病药物研发难、成本高、成功率低
AI可用于靶点发现与分子设计
数字孪生、合成对照组等新兴方法

abstract: [Canadian journal of psychiatry. Revue canadienne de psychiatrie] Plain Language SummaryHow Artificial Intelligence Could Improve Psychiatric Drug DevelopmentDeveloping new medicines for mental health conditions is difficult, expensive, and often unsuccessful. One reason is that people with the same diagnosis can differ greatly in their underlying biology and in how they respond to treatment. Clinical trials also rely heavily on symptom ratings and can be affected by placebo responses. This editorial explains how artificial intelligence (AI) could help at several stages of psychiatric drug development. AI can help researchers identify promising drug targets, design new treatment molecules, and use biological, brain-imaging, and clinical data to predict treatment response and improve clinical trials. Emerging approaches include digital twins, synthetic control groups, and digital measures of symptoms and behaviour. However, these technologies are still developing and should not be viewed as a solution to all the challenges of psychiatric drug development. Wider use will require representative datasets, strong data governance, transparent and interpretable models, rigorous clinical validation, and appropriate regulation.
zh_abstract: [加拿大精神病学杂志（Canadian journal of psychiatry. Revue canadienne de psychiatrie）] 通俗摘要：人工智能如何改善精神科药物研发。研发针对精神健康状况的新药困难、昂贵，且常常失败。原因之一是，诊断相同的人在潜在生物学特征和治疗反应上可能差异很大。临床试验也在很大程度上依赖症状评分，并可能受到安慰剂反应的影响。这篇社论阐述了人工智能（AI）如何在精神科药物研发的多个阶段提供帮助。AI可以帮助研究人员识别有前景的药物靶点、设计新的治疗分子，并利用生物学、脑影像和临床数据来预测治疗反应并改进临床试验。新兴方法包括数字孪生、合成对照组，以及症状和行为的数字化测量。然而，这些技术仍在发展之中，不应被视为解决精神科药物研发所有挑战的万能方案。更广泛的应用将需要具有代表性的数据集、强有力的数据治理、透明且可解释的模型、严格的临床验证以及适当的监管。

title: Deep-learning-based contrast synthesis in knee magnetic resonance imaging: performance across multiple target contrasts.
zh_title: 基于深度学习的膝关节MRI对比度合成：多目标对比度表现
summary: 在88名有膝关节症状志愿者中，用U-Net由磁共振指纹成像数据合成T1w、增强T1w脂肪抑制和DESS，合成图像质量仅略低于常规图像。
key_points: U-Net从MRF数据合成三种未测量对比度
两名放射科医师评估图像质量
纳入78例分析，样本量小

abstract: [Magma (New York, N.Y.)] Quantitative MRI has been held back, because it increases scan time on top of clinical protocols. In this cross-sectional study, we explore how accurately unmeasured contrasts can be synthesized from magnetic resonance fingerprinting (MRF) data. MRF, T1-weighted (T1w), gadolinium-enhanced T1w fat-saturated (Gd T1w fs), and double-echo steady-state (DESS) data were acquired at 3 T from volunteers having knee joint symptoms (n=88). Ten subjects were excluded due to missing MRF-data. U-Nets were trained to synthesize the other contrasts out of the MRF data, and the image quality was evaluated for both the synthetic and conventional by two radiologists. Presence of synovitis was evaluated from Gd T1w fs images. Wilcoxon signed-rank test was utilized to test differences in the image quality scores. Synthetic images overall had only slightly lower image quality in radiologists' evaluation for T1w (3.54 vs 3.88, p<0.01), DESS (3.22 vs 3.90, p<0.01), and Gd T1w fs images (3.40 vs 3.76, p<0.01). Synovitis could not be reliably observed from synthetic Gd T1w fs images. The image quality gap observed earlier persisted in this study and manifested itself steadily across all the joint tissues. Synovitis assessment was not possible from the synthetic contrast-enhanced images.
zh_abstract: [Magma (New York, N.Y.)] 定量 MRI 的推广受到限制，因为它会在临床方案之外增加扫描时间。在这项横断面研究中，我们探讨了从磁共振指纹成像（MRF）数据合成未实际测量的对比度图像的准确程度。在 3 T 下采集了有膝关节症状的志愿者（n=88）的 MRF、T1 加权（T1w）、钆增强 T1 加权脂肪抑制（Gd T1w fs）及双回波稳态（DESS）数据。由于缺少 MRF 数据，排除 10 名受试者。训练 U-Net 从 MRF 数据合成其他对比度图像，并由两名放射科医师对合成图像和常规图像的图像质量进行评估。通过 Gd T1w fs 图像评估滑膜炎的存在情况。采用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验比较图像质量评分的差异。在放射科医师的评估中，合成图像总体上的图像质量仅略低：T1w（3.54 对 3.88，p<0.01）、DESS（3.22 对 3.90，p<0.01）、Gd T1w fs 图像（3.40 对 3.76，p<0.01）。无法从合成的 Gd T1w fs 图像中可靠地观察到滑膜炎。此前观察到的图像质量差距在本研究中依然存在，并且在所有关节组织中表现一致。无法通过合成的对比增强图像评估滑膜炎。

title: Role of Artificial Intelligence in Radiation Oncology: A Missed Opportunity for LMICs?
source: PubMed · International journal of radiation oncology, biology, physics
zh_title: 放疗中的人工智能：中低收入国家错失的机会？
summary: 综述AI/ML在放疗各环节的应用，并指出中低收入国家的采用差距与验证证据不足。
key_points: AI可自动勾画、计划与质控
可缓解LMICs肿瘤医师与物理师短缺
