reason: 综述类，上限6；泛述性，增量档
abstract: [International journal of radiation oncology, biology, physics] Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) are driving a major shift in modern medicine, particularly within radiation oncology. AI in radiation oncology offers low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) a way to offset critical shortages of oncologists and physicists by automating segmentation, planning, and quality checks, improving efficiency, and expanding equitable access to care. Its actual value depends on validation against LMICs' infrastructure and patient populations, an area where current evidence remains limited. This review aims to comprehensively summarize the current evidence on AI and ML applications across key domains of radiotherapy, while highlighting global disparities in adoption, particularly in LMICs. This critical review conducted a comprehensive literature search across PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library for studies published between 2010 and April 2026. Only relevant studies emphasizing the efficiency of AI in radiation workflow and the existing gaps in its adoption within LMICs were included in this review. Eleven studies published between 2019 and 2025 were included. Study designs comprised original research (n=5), reviews (n=4), a survey (n=1), and a study protocol (n=1). Studies were conducted across multiple LMICs in Africa, Asia, and Latin America, predominantly evaluating AI-based contouring and treatment-planning tools, with Radiation Planning Assistant (RPA) being the most frequently reported platform. AI tools demonstrated comparable performance in LMICs relative to High-Income Countries (HICs), particularly with regard to time efficiency and the quality of target volume contouring. Yet the majority of LMICs still don't have AI tools in their radiation centers to work efficiently. The current literature reveals a gap between the need for AI in radiation oncology in LMICs and the available evidence supporting its implementation. LMICs could benefit substantially from AI-enabled improvements in radiation oncology. Several conclusions about the applicability of these findings in LMIC settings were drawn by extrapolation from studies conducted in HIC contexts, which substantially limits their direct generalizability to lower-resource environments. Cost-effective and accessible AI models hold promise to address workforce shortages, improve efficiency, and expand equitable access to quality radiotherapy services.
zh_abstract: [International journal of radiation oncology, biology, physics] 人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）正在推动现代医学发生重大转变，在放射肿瘤学领域尤为突出。放射肿瘤学中的 AI 通过自动化勾画、计划制定和质量检查，提高效率并扩大公平获得医疗的机会，为低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）弥补肿瘤医师和物理师的严重短缺提供了途径。其实际价值取决于针对 LMICs 的基础设施和患者人群进行的验证，而这方面目前的证据仍然有限。本综述旨在全面总结 AI 和 ML 在放射治疗关键领域应用的现有证据，同时强调全球在应用方面的差距，尤其是在 LMICs。本批判性综述在 PubMed、Embase 和 Cochrane Library 中对 2010 年至 2026 年 4 月发表的研究进行了全面文献检索。本综述仅纳入强调 AI 在放疗工作流程中的效率以及 LMICs 在应用方面现有差距的相关研究。共纳入 2019 年至 2025 年发表的 11 项研究。研究设计包括原始研究（n=5）、综述（n=4）、调查（n=1）和研究方案（n=1）。这些研究在非洲、亚洲和拉丁美洲的多个 LMICs 中开展，主要评估基于 AI 的勾画和治疗计划工具，其中放射计划助手（Radiation Planning Assistant，RPA）是报道最多的平台。AI 工具在 LMICs 中的表现与高收入国家（HICs）相当，尤其是在时间效率和靶区勾画质量方面。然而，大多数 LMICs 的放疗中心仍没有可用于提高工作效率的 AI 工具。现有文献显示，LMICs 在放射肿瘤学中对 AI 的需求与支持其实施的现有证据之间存在差距。LMICs 可从 AI 带来的放射肿瘤学改进中获得显著益处。关于这些发现在 LMIC 环境中适用性的若干结论，是由 HIC 背景下开展的研究外推得出的，这极大地限制了其直接推广到资源较少环境的适用性。具有成本效益且易于获得的 AI 模型有望解决人力短缺、提高效率并扩大获得高质量放疗服务的公平性。

title: Large Language Models for Accurate Medical Chart Abstraction: Enabling Scalable and Secure Artificial Intelligence Deployment in Stroke
zh_title: 大语言模型用于卒中病历摘录：可扩展且安全的AI部署
summary: 在三家医院2416份神经介入卒中报告上，评估22个开源指令微调LLM，用快速应答与思维链提示抽取8个临床变量。
key_points: 22个开源LLM，对比架构、规模与生物医学适配
以非专家标注为参考，并有医师复核分歧病例
评估准确率、推理延迟与专家一致性
reason: 多院样本较大、模型对比充分，但为预印本、参考标准较弱
abstract: Medical chart abstraction transforms unstructured clinical narratives into structured variables for research and quality monitoring. We evaluated a prompting-based large language model (LLM) framework for extracting eight clinical variables from 2,416 neurointerventional acute stroke intervention reports across three hospitals. Twenty-two instruction-tuned open-source LLMs were evaluated across architectures, model sizes, and biomedical adaptations using Quick Response and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. Non-expert staff annotations served as the cross-model reference standard. Evaluation was restricted to report-variable pairs with a valid LLaMA3.3-70B CoT prediction and a corresponding reference label. Performance measures included extraction accuracy, inference latency, and agreement with expert adjudication. Twenty discordant cases per variable underwent review by two senior physicians and four medical students. LLaMA3.3-70B achieved the highest overall accuracy (94.8%). CoT improved performance on inference-dependent variables such as site of occlusion, while Quick Response was optimal for directly stated procedural fields. Expert adjudication showed that AI predictions were more closely aligned with expert interpretations than non-expert annotations for most variables, with intracranial angioplasty remaining a challenge. Locally deployed LLMs can support scalable clinical information extraction and retrospective stroke registry curation, with expert oversight for ambiguous cases.
zh_abstract: 病历摘录将非结构化的临床叙述转化为用于研究和质量监测的结构化变量。我们评估了一种基于提示的大语言模型（LLM）框架，用于从三家医院的2,416份神经介入急性卒中干预报告中提取八个临床变量。采用快速应答（Quick Response）和思维链（CoT）提示，对22个经指令微调的开源LLM在不同架构、模型规模和生物医学适配方面进行了评估。以非专家工作人员的标注作为跨模型参考标准。评估仅限于具有有效LLaMA3.3-70B CoT预测结果及相应参考标签的报告-变量对。性能指标包括提取准确率、推理延迟以及与专家裁定的一致性。每个变量的20例不一致病例由两名资深医师和四名医学生进行复核。LLaMA3.3-70B取得了最高的总体准确率（94.8%）。CoT提高了依赖推断的变量（如闭塞部位）的表现，而快速应答对直接陈述的操作字段最为理想。专家裁定显示，对大多数变量而言，AI预测比非专家标注更接近专家解读，其中颅内血管成形术仍是一项挑战。本地部署的LLM可支持可扩展的临床信息提取和回顾性卒中登记库整理，但对模糊病例需有专家监督。

title: DES-JEPA: Learning a Shared Vocabulary for High-Dimensional Discrete Event Sequences
zh_title: DES-JEPA：为高维离散事件序列学习共享词表
summary: 提出DES-JEPA等模块，为跨领域、高维离散事件序列（含患者临床事件轨迹）学习共享离散词表，以突破现有基础模型事件类型数量受限的问题。
key_points: 针对跨域事件词表不一致问题
采用联合嵌入预测架构
面向高维事件流，含临床事件轨迹
reason: 事件序列基础模型方向有新意，医疗仅为应用之一，预印本
abstract: Temporal foundation models such as Chronos and TimesFM generalize across domains through a shared numerical observation space. In contrast, discrete event sequences (DESs), including operational event logs or patient clinical-event trajectories, have domain-specific event vocabularies whose labels lack a consistent correspondence across domains. Beyond this lack of consistency, the number of distinct events in real-world settings is high enough to challenge both classical temporal point process modeling and current in-context foundation inference models such as FIM-PP. Critically, current foundation models for DESs are limited to a small, fixed number of event types, restricting their applicability to realistic, high-dimensional event streams. To address this, we propose two complementary modules: (i) DES-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture that learns a shared discrete vocabulary from synthetic stochastic processes with unaligned event vocabularies; and (ii) DES-PFN, a discrete event sequence prior-fitted network that reuses the learned vocabulary for in-context next-event prediction. Without task-specific fine-tuning, this framework achieves competitive zero-shot performance on eight unseen real-world datasets and scales up to 700 distinct event types.
zh_abstract: Chronos 和 TimesFM 等时间序列基础模型通过共享的数值观测空间实现跨领域泛化。相比之下，离散事件序列（DES），包括运行事件日志或患者临床事件轨迹，具有特定领域的事件词表，其标签在不同领域之间缺乏一致的对应关系。除这种不一致性之外，真实场景中不同事件的数量之多，足以对经典时间点过程建模以及当前的上下文基础推断模型（如 FIM-PP）构成挑战。关键在于，现有面向 DES 的基础模型仅限于少量固定的事件类型，限制了其在现实的高维事件流中的适用性。为此，我们提出两个互补的模块：（i）DES-JEPA，一种联合嵌入预测架构，从事件词表未对齐的合成随机过程中学习共享的离散词表；（ii）DES-PFN，一种离散事件序列先验拟合网络（prior-fitted network），复用所学词表进行上下文内的下一事件预测。在无需针对具体任务微调的情况下，该框架在八个未见过的真实世界数据集上取得了具有竞争力的零样本性能，并可扩展至 700 种不同的事件类型。

title: Rubricon: Automated Rubric Generation and Refinement for LLM Evaluation and Training
zh_title: Rubricon：用于LLM评估与训练的自动评分细则生成与优化
summary: 提出无需人工偏好标注的评分细则生成流程，在含临床在内的五个基准上，与专家细则的一致性较最佳合成基线提高9%。
key_points: 采样多份细则并选取区分度最高者
依据通过率补充遗漏标准、剔除浅层标准
五个基准上与专家细则一致性提升9%
reason: 通用LLM评估方法，含临床基准，有基线对比，医疗特异性有限
abstract: Rubrics enable reward assignment on tasks without verifiable answers, but are expensive to manually produce from scratch. We present Rubricon, a pipeline that generates discriminative rubrics without requiring human preference labels, rubric annotation, or generator-model training. Using any LLM, Rubricon samples multiple rubrics, selects the most discriminative candidate, adds criteria to capture overlooked requirements or response flaws, and prunes criteria that are misaligned or shallow. Alongside LLM self-critique and test-time scaling, Rubricon uses observed criterion pass rates on example model responses to guide refinement. Across five professional, consumer, clinical, and general-use LLM benchmarks, Rubricon produces rubrics whose scores of frontier LLM responses exhibit 9% greater alignment with labor-intensive expert-authored rubrics, compared to the best alternative synthetic rubric generation method among RRD, QSRG, OpenRubrics, and agentic generation via harnesses like Codex. On HealthBench, post-training a Qwen3.5-9B model with Rubricon rubrics yields 4.5% better performance than training with rubrics from the strongest alternative synthetic rubric generator, RRD.
zh_abstract: 评分细则（rubric）可以在没有可验证答案的任务上实现奖励分配，但从零开始人工编写成本高昂。我们提出 Rubricon，这是一种无需人类偏好标注、评分细则标注或生成器模型训练即可生成具有区分度的评分细则的流程。Rubricon 可使用任意大语言模型（LLM），对多份评分细则进行采样，选出最具区分度的候选，补充评价标准以涵盖被忽略的要求或回答缺陷，并剔除不一致或流于表面的标准。除 LLM 自我批评和测试时扩展外，Rubricon 还利用示例模型回答上观察到的各标准通过率来指导细则的优化。在五个涵盖专业、消费、临床和通用场景的 LLM 基准上，与 RRD、QSRG、OpenRubrics 以及通过 Codex 等框架（harness）进行的智能体式生成这几种替代性合成评分细则生成方法中表现最好的一种相比，Rubricon 生成的评分细则对前沿 LLM 回答的评分与耗费大量人力的专家撰写评分细则的一致性高出 9%。在 HealthBench 上，使用 Rubricon 评分细则对 Qwen3.5-9B 模型进行后训练，其表现比使用最强替代合成评分细则生成方法 RRD 的评分细则训练高出 4.5%。

title: EUReCA: End-to-End Unified CBCT Reconstruction Across Clinical Acquisitions
zh_title: EUReCA：跨临床采集的端到端统一CBCT重建
summary: 提出几何感知前馈模型EUReCA，单套权重即可处理8-100个投影的直线加速器CBCT重建，结合学习特征与FDK重建。
key_points: 单一权重支持8-100个投影，无需按视图数重训
多尺度骨干编码投影并按采集几何反投影到3D网格
架构与训练方案可扩展到其他临床轨迹
reason: 新颖方法预印本，摘要未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image-guided radiotherapy, but reducing the number of projections to lower dose and scan time makes reconstruction increasingly ill-posed. We present EUReCA (End-to-end Unified REconstruction across Clinical Acquisitions), a geometry-aware feed-forward model for variable-view clinical linac CBCT. For a given acquisition trajectory, EUReCA accepts 8-100 projections with a single set of weights, without view-count-specific retraining; the same architecture and training recipe extend unchanged to other clinical trajectories. It combines learned projection features with an in-frame Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstruction. The model encodes each projection with a shared multiscale backbone, back-projects features into multiresolution 3D grids using the acquisition geometry, aggregates variable numbers of views at fixed computational cost, and refines the volume with a global 3D transformer and multilevel decoder. On simulated data, EUReCA achieved 29.9-33.2 dB PSNR with 10-100 views and outperformed all applicable feed-forward baselines; it also exceeded iterative optimization-based methods while running orders of magnitude faster. On 15 measured patient CBCT scans evaluated against vendor reconstructions, EUReCA achieved the best performance at every tested view count. These results suggest that geometry-aware, measurement-anchored feed-forward reconstruction can provide a practical and flexible foundation for variable-view linac CBCT.
zh_abstract: 锥形束计算机断层成像（CBCT）广泛用于图像引导放疗，但减少投影数量以降低剂量和扫描时间会使重建的病态程度日益加重。我们提出 EUReCA（End-to-end Unified REconstruction across Clinical Acquisitions），一种面向可变视图临床直线加速器 CBCT 的几何感知前馈模型。对于给定的采集轨迹，EUReCA 以同一组权重接受 8-100 个投影，无需针对特定视图数进行重新训练；相同的架构和训练方案可不加改动地推广到其他临床轨迹。该模型将学习得到的投影特征与帧内（in-frame）Feldkamp-Davis-Kress（FDK）重建相结合。模型使用共享的多尺度骨干网络对每个投影进行编码，利用采集几何将特征反投影到多分辨率三维网格中，以固定的计算成本聚合数量可变的视图，并通过全局三维 Transformer 和多级解码器对体数据进行精修。在模拟数据上，EUReCA 在 10-100 个视图下取得 29.9-33.2 dB 的 PSNR，优于所有适用的前馈基线；同时也超过了基于迭代优化的方法，且运行速度快若干个数量级。在 15 例实测患者 CBCT 扫描上，以厂商重建结果为参照进行评估，EUReCA 在每个测试视图数下均取得最佳表现。这些结果表明，几何感知、以测量为锚定的前馈重建可为可变视图直线加速器 CBCT 提供实用且灵活的基础。

title: SparseTokenGS: Gaussian-based Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction via Reusable Token Pool
zh_title: SparseTokenGS：基于可复用Token池的高斯稀疏视角CBCT重建
summary: 提出以可复用token池让坐标解码检索全扫描信息的高斯稀疏视角CBCT重建方法，缓解体数据不一致问题。
key_points: 针对前馈高斯方法无法在解码时检索全局信息
锚点Token融合与点-Token注意力查询共享池
面向牙科与影像引导介入的低剂量成像
reason: 有新意的方法预印本，摘要未见临床验证
abstract: Sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography is widely used for fast, low-dose volumetric imaging and lesion localization in dentistry and image-guided interventions, but it introduces severe artifacts. Feed-forward Gaussian methods transfer the reconstruction cost to training and decode each coordinate from projection-aligned features and neighboring anchors. However, information from the whole scan is written only when the field is constructed and cannot be retrieved during coordinate decoding, leaving the volume inconsistent within the scan. This is a common limitation of such methods: once the field is fixed, decoding uses only local features and reconstruction quality drops substantially. We propose SparseTokenGS, a Gaussian-based method for sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography reconstruction via a reusable token pool. Anchor Token Fusion and Point-Token Attention query this shared pool at the anchors and at the query coordinates, respectively. The local Gaussian prior is retained, and the volume is reconstructed in one forward pass, without per-scan optimization or a projection-domain loss. On three public chest and dental datasets, SparseTokenGS achieves the highest reconstruction performance among the compared methods. On clinical dental scans, reconstruction from only six projections reaches 29.51 decibels in peak signal-to-noise ratio and a structural similarity of 0.842 against the full-view reference, and off-the-shelf tooth-and-pulp segmentation keeps these structures separable for root-canal localization. Experiments on volcanic rock and chicken show performance after same-object adaptation. A reusable token pool gives feed-forward reconstruction a mechanism that keeps scan-wide context available through decoding and can benefit future rapid clinical lesion localization and analysis. The code is available at: https://github.com/FrankDengAI/SparseTokenGS.
zh_abstract: 稀疏视角锥束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）广泛应用于牙科和影像引导介入中的快速、低剂量容积成像与病灶定位，但会产生严重伪影。前馈式高斯方法将重建成本转移到训练阶段，并根据与投影对齐的特征及邻近锚点对每个坐标进行解码。然而，整个扫描的信息仅在构建场时写入，在坐标解码过程中无法被检索，导致扫描内的体数据不一致。这是此类方法的一个普遍局限：一旦场被固定，解码仅使用局部特征，重建质量会大幅下降。我们提出 SparseTokenGS，这是一种基于高斯的方法，通过可复用的 token 池进行稀疏视角锥束 CT 重建。锚点 token 融合（Anchor Token Fusion）与点-token 注意力（Point-Token Attention）分别在锚点处和查询坐标处查询该共享池。该方法保留了局部高斯先验，并通过一次前向传播完成体数据重建，无需逐扫描优化，也无需投影域损失。在三个公开的胸部和牙科数据集上，SparseTokenGS 在所比较的方法中取得了最高的重建性能。在临床牙科扫描中，仅用六个投影进行重建，相对于全视角参考图像，峰值信噪比达到 29.51 分贝，结构相似性为 0.842，并且现成的牙齿与牙髓分割方法仍能使这些结构保持可分离，以用于根管定位。在火山岩和鸡的实验中展示了同一对象自适应之后的性能。可复用的 token 池为前馈式重建提供了一种机制，使全扫描范围的上下文在解码过程中始终可用，并有望惠及未来的快速临床病灶定位与分析。代码可在 https://github.com/FrankDengAI/SparseTokenGS 获取。

title: SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World
zh_title: SciGame：在真实与反事实世界中评测科学发现智能体
summary: 提出SciGame基准，将科学文献转为结构化卡片，生成原始与反事实环境，在识别与开放发现设定下评测大模型智能体，涵盖五个前沿模型。
key_points: 文献转结构化卡片，生成原始与反事实环境
含历史定律集与知识截止后的时序集
五个前沿模型实验，熟悉先验会影响表现
reason: 科学发现智能体新基准，属预印本，非医疗专属，证据有限
abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery. However, existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming, score data fitting instead of prediction on unseen inputs, and do not separate empirical evidence from pretrained priors. We introduce SciGame, a controlled benchmark that converts scientific literature into structured scientific cards. Each card yields a pair of Original and dimensionally consistent Counterfactual environments with the same task interface. SciGame contains a Historical collection of canonical laws and a live Temporal collection curated from papers published after model knowledge cutoffs. It evaluates agents in candidate-guided Identification and open-ended Discovery settings. Each setting runs under Prior-only, Fixed, and Adaptive protocols. Experiments on five frontier models yield three findings. First, familiar priors hurt performance once the governing relation is altered. Second, adaptive experimentation helps the strongest models but harms weaker ones under limited budgets. Third, good explanations can hide quantitative failures. Recovering the exact symbolic form remains the main bottleneck, even when agents interpret evidence correctly. Current agents can investigate systems actively, but inducing exact laws in unfamiliar settings remains an open challenge.

title: Detecting Brain Cancer Progression Through Signatures of Wearable Accelerometry Data
zh_title: 基于可穿戴加速度计特征签名检测脑癌进展
summary: 预印本利用粗路径签名从BrainWear研究中高级别胶质瘤患者的腕戴加速度计数据提取特征，以区分疾病稳定与进展状态。
key_points: 对象为高级别胶质瘤患者，数据来自BrainWear研究
将加速度计记录转为步行路径片段并提取路径签名
目标是在两次MRI之间连续监测功能变化
reason: 可穿戴+肿瘤进展预测，新颖方法；摘要无外部验证，预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Glioblastoma and other high-grade gliomas (HGG) have a poor prognosis and are associated with progressive functional decline. The standard of care to assess progressive disease is contrast-enhanced MRI, which is expensive, claustrophobic, and performed only once every 2-3 months. Wearable accelerometers offer a non-invasive alternative for continuously monitoring patient function between clinic visits. However, accelerometry data streams are typically noisy and highly patient-specific, making conventional time series methods and summary statistics poorly suited to detecting clinically meaningful change. This work aims to classify stable versus progressive disease states by applying rough path signatures for feature extraction from wrist-worn accelerometer data. We convert accelerometer recordings from HGG patients enrolled in the BrainWear study into walking-path segments and use signature kernel maximum mean discrepancy (SigMMD) to quantify change in patients' walking behaviour. We overcome the challenge of inter-patient heterogeneity by adjusting for the natural variation in a patient's walking during stable tumour periods. This patient-specific normalisation substantially improves separation, yielding a candidate biomarker of tumour progression. Our results provide proof-of-concept evidence that signature-based analysis of wearable accelerometry can distinguish stable from progressive disease states, motivating larger longitudinal studies of continuous wearable monitoring as a digital biomarker in neuro-oncology.

title: DiaBench: A Benchmarking Framework to Evaluate the Performance of LLMs in T2D Patient Education
zh_title: DiaBench：评估LLM在2型糖尿病患者教育中表现的基准框架
summary: 基于96组临床真实问答构建基准，由GPT-5转为选择题并经专家小组验证，用于评估LLM在不同健康素养下的T2D教育表现。
key_points: 96组临床医生收集的真实问答
GPT-5转换为三种配置的选择题
由糖尿病教育专家、医生和内分泌医生验证
reason: 新基准且有专家验证，但规模小、预印本
abstract: Background Effective type 2 diabetes (T2D) education improves patient outcomes, but clinician time constraints limit what can be covered during encounters. Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable way to answer patient questions, yet their accuracy and reliability in T2D education across health literacy levels remain poorly characterized. Methods We developed DiaBench, a standardized benchmarking framework built from 96 question-and-answer pairs collected by clinicians from representative real-world patient encounters. GPT-5 transformed each pair into multiple-choice questions (MCQs) under three configurations (1-3) simulating different question formats and levels of user background. A five-member panel of certified diabetes care and education specialists (CDCESs), medical doctors (MDs), and endocrinologists validated the transformations, rating question rephrasing, answer rephrasing, and answer correctness. We then evaluated seven LLMs (GPT-51, Gemini-2.5-Flash2, Cohere Command3, Llama-44, DeepSeek-R15, Perplexity Sonar6, Mistral-Large-2.07) for accuracy and self-consistency across three runs. Results (i) Expert validation showed a consensus over MCQ transformation. For configuration 1, 98.1% (SD 0.01) of rephrased answers were appropriate, 98.1% (SD 0.01) of MCQ answers were correct, and 95.0% (SD 0.05) of rephrased questions were appropriate; corresponding values for configuration 2 were 96.3% (SD 0.05), 97.5% (SD 0.02), and 89.8% (SD 0.14). (ii) across benchmarking for configurations 1 and 2, most models achieved high accuracy ([≥]95%), but Mistral-Large-2.0, Llama 4, and Perplexity Sonar showed substantially lower self-consistency (60.4%-91.7%) than other models ([≥]95%). All models degraded in both accuracy and self-consistency on configuration 3. Conclusions DiaBench quantitatively differentiates LLM capability in T2D patient education, with Gemini, GPT-5, and DeepSeek-R1 performing strongly and other models suboptimally. DiaBench provides a transferable platform for evaluating existing and newly developed LLMs, addressing the need for standardized benchmarking before clinical deployment of LLM-based systems in patient education.
zh_abstract: 【背景】有效的2型糖尿病（T2D）教育可改善患者结局，但临床医生的时间限制了诊疗过程中能够涵盖的内容。大语言模型（LLM）为回答患者问题提供了一种可扩展的方式，然而其在不同健康素养水平下进行T2D教育的准确性和可靠性仍缺乏充分刻画。【方法】我们开发了 DiaBench，这是一个标准化基准测试框架，基于临床医生从具有代表性的真实世界患者诊疗中收集的96组问答对构建。GPT-5 在三种配置（1–3）下将每组问答对转换为多项选择题（MCQ），分别模拟不同的提问形式和用户背景水平。由认证糖尿病护理与教育专家（CDCES）、内科医生（MD）和内分泌科医生组成的五人小组对转换结果进行验证，评定问题改写、答案改写和答案正确性。随后，我们评估了七个 LLM（GPT-5¹、Gemini-2.5-Flash²、Cohere Command³、Llama-4⁴、DeepSeek-R1⁵、Perplexity Sonar⁶、Mistral-Large-2.0⁷）在三次运行中的准确性和自一致性。【结果】（i）专家验证显示对MCQ转换达成共识。对于配置1，98.1%（SD 0.01）的改写答案合适，98.1%（SD 0.01）的MCQ答案正确，95.0%（SD 0.05）的改写问题合适；配置2的相应数值分别为96.3%（SD 0.05）、97.5%（SD 0.02）和89.8%（SD 0.14）。（ii）在配置1和2的基准测试中，大多数模型达到较高准确率（≥95%），但 Mistral-Large-2.0、Llama 4 和 Perplexity Sonar 的自一致性（60.4%–91.7%）显著低于其他模型（≥95%）。在配置3中，所有模型的准确性和自一致性均有所下降。【结论】DiaBench 能够定量区分 LLM 在T2D患者教育中的能力，其中 Gemini、GPT-5 和 DeepSeek-R1 表现突出，其他模型表现欠佳。DiaBench 提供了一个可迁移的平台，可用于评估现有和新开发的 LLM，满足基于 LLM 的系统在患者教育中临床部署之前进行标准化基准测试的需求。

title: Interpreting Graph Neural Networks for Antibacterial Drug Repurposing against Acinetobacter baumannii
zh_title: 解释图神经网络用于鲍曼不动杆菌抗菌药物重定位
summary: 图神经网络集成在抗菌筛选中与含描述符的参考模型性能相当，原子级解释指出哌嗪等结构特征。
key_points: 仅用原子特征与连接性
性能与描述符增强模型相当
原子级扰动解释识别支持活性的特征
reason: 药物发现方向有可解释性分析，预印本证据有限
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance in Acinetobacter baumannii, whose carbapenem-resistant strains are classified by the World Health Organization as a critical priority, has motivated machine-learning screens for new antibacterials, but translating predictions into chemical hypotheses requires evaluating the molecular features on which a model relies. A graph neural network ensemble achieves competitive predictive performance against a descriptor-augmented reference model on the same antibacterial screen while using only atom features and connectivity, allowing interpretation to focus on the molecular graph without a separate input of handcrafted descriptors. The atom-level explanations identify features supporting the model's activity predictions under perturbation and restoration, while comparisons with equally sized perturbations within each molecule distinguish piperazine as the most consistently supported recurring contributor to predicted activity. Prospective screening of the Drug Repurposing Hub followed by developability and safety assessment yields a ranked shortlist for experimental follow-up and leads to testing of CE3F4, which reduced A. baumannii growth by 57% at 0.25 mM in a preliminary assay with a non-monotonic concentration--response profile.
zh_abstract: 鲍曼不动杆菌（Acinetobacter baumannii）的抗菌药物耐药性问题——其耐碳青霉烯菌株被世界卫生组织列为极其重要的优先病原体——推动了用于筛选新型抗菌药物的机器学习筛选，但要将预测转化为化学假设，需要评估模型所依赖的分子特征。在同一抗菌药物筛选数据上，一个图神经网络集成模型仅使用原子特征和连接关系，就取得了与加入描述符的参考模型相当的预测性能，使解释工作可以聚焦于分子图本身，而无需另行输入人工设计的描述符。原子水平的解释通过扰动和恢复，识别出支持模型活性预测的特征；同时，通过与每个分子内部同等大小的扰动进行比较，确定哌嗪是对预测活性贡献最一致、且反复出现的特征。随后对药物重定位中心（Drug Repurposing Hub）进行前瞻性筛选，并开展可开发性和安全性评估，得到一份可供实验跟进的排序候选清单，并据此检测了 CE3F4；在一项初步实验中，CE3F4 在 0.25 mM 时使鲍曼不动杆菌生长降低57%，其浓度–反应曲线呈非单调性。

title: Photograph-Based Skeletal Malocclusion Screening with Geometric Machine Learning: External Validation Across Turkish and Non-European Cohorts
zh_title: 基于照片的骨性错颌筛查几何机器学习：土耳其与非欧洲队列外部验证
summary: 预印本用侧面智能手机照片提取100个几何特征筛查骨性错颌，并在两个未参与训练的独立队列中进行外部验证。
key_points: 无需放射影像的非侵入式分诊
两项二分类任务，默认阈值直接应用
外部队列分别来自土耳其机构与比利时私人诊所
reason: 有两个独立外部队列验证，但为预印本，场景较窄
abstract: A photograph based screening classifier for skeletal malocclusion maps 100 engineered geometric feature vectors, derived from a side-profile smartphone photograph, to orthodontic class labels, enabling non-invasive triage without radiographic imaging. This study reports external validation across two independent cohorts that contributed no cases to training. Two binary tasks were evaluated; Class III against non-Class III, and Class I against Class II; each with its own development set and model, applied without modification at the default threshold. One external cohort was Turkish, drawn from an institution not represented in the development set; the other was a non-European cohort from a Belgian private orthodontic clinic. Sensitivity, specificity and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) were pre-specified as primary outcome measures, since none depends on outcome prevalence. In the Class III task, sensitivity was similar across all three evaluation sets (0.801, 0.836, 0.848; all adjusted p>0.7), while specificity fell from 0.766 in the Turkish external cohort to 0.697 in the non-European cohort. AUC was 0.902 and 0.835 respectively (difference 0.066; p=0.029). In the Class I and Class II task the corresponding values were 0.875 and 0.723 (difference 0.152; p<0.001). A subgroup analysis showed lower sensitivity in children than adults across both cohorts (0.71 to 0.80 versus 0.89 to 0.90). AUC was lower in the non-European cohort for all three models in both tasks. The observed performance differences are consistent with a population-specific generalizability effect rather than model-specific failure and support mandatory external validation on target populations before clinical deployment.

abstract: Radiomics extracts quantitative features describing tumor shape, intensity, and texture from medical images to build models that predict clinical outcomes. However, large feature sets increase the risk of overfitting in small datasets, and building an end-to-end workflow often requires programming expertise. We present MEDiml (Medical Image Analysis with Machine Learning), open-source radiomics software available as a Python package (MEDiml-pkg) and a no-code desktop application (MEDiml-app). Both run on the same computational engine, and code generation exports graphically configured workflows as executable Python code. Feature extraction follows the Image Biomarker Standardization Initiative (IBSI) standards. MEDiml is built around complexity minimization: features are grouped into levels of increasing complexity (morphological, intensity, textural,l and filter-based), a model is trained at each level, and the simplest level not significantly outperformed by more complex ones is retained. Applied to five oncological datasets (2,104 scans), MEDiml achieved AUCs of 0.65 to 0.82, with morphological or intensity features sufficient in four of the five tasks. Resources: www.mediml.app.

abstract: Antibodies recognized as foreign can elicit anti-drug antibodies that compromise efficacy and safety, making humanness scoring---estimating how human-like a sequence appears---an early, repeated step in antibody development. Widely used scores reduce a variable domain to one framework-dominated number, leaving the complementarity-determining regions (CDRs)---grafted during humanization, diversified by generative models---weakly supervised and rarely audited. Here we introduce IgScope, a 23-million-parameter antibody language model trained from scratch that scores humanness at chain, IMGT-region and residue resolution; a region-isolated attention module confines attention to within-region pairs, and chimeric-sequence training supplies region-level supervision. On 2.38 million held-out chains, masking all framework tokens leaves CDR accuracy unchanged, and back-mutated murine residues in human frameworks are detected at 93.4% accuracy. At chain level, IgScope matches the strongest published correlation with clinical anti-drug-antibody incidence (r = $-$0.567, n = 217) and outperforms a same-protocol recomputation. Region-level scoring exposes what chain-level scoring conceals: antibodies designed de novo by four generative models pass whole-chain humanness (0.966--0.988) while their CDRs score far below natural (P $<$ 1e-30) in every chain class. Quality control turns the same resolution to the mirror-image question: in humanized-mouse platforms, whose domains are human by design, IgScope scores the domain as human and, in HUGO-Nano chimeric VHHs, isolates only the FR2 signal of four camelid hallmark residues deliberately retained to stabilise the VHH. IgScope gives antibody humanization a verified foundation and generative design an audit.

abstract: [European journal of medicinal chemistry] Viral infectious diseases remain a major global health burden, underscoring the urgent need for efficient strategies to identify novel antiviral agents, particularly those with broad-spectrum activity and a high barrier to resistance. With the rapid accumulation of diverse biological and chemical data, artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being integrated into antiviral drug discovery to accelerate candidate identification and optimization. In this review, we summarize major data resources for AI-assisted antiviral research, including viral genome databases, viral protein databases, virus-host protein interaction databases, antiviral compound activity databases, compound structure databases, and viral mutation and drug resistance databases. We then review representative AI methods and applications across key tasks in antiviral drug discovery, including target-based drug discovery, phenotype-based drug discovery, and viral mutation and drug resistance prediction. We also summarize representative antiviral candidates from AI-assisted studies and their reported activities. Finally, we discuss current challenges and future opportunities in AI-assisted antiviral drug discovery. We believe that the continued advances in data resources and AI methodologies will accelerate the development of more effective antiviral agents.

abstract: [Computer methods in biomechanics and biomedical engineering] Finite element analysis (FEA) is widely used to evaluate dental implant biomechanics but is computationally demanding. This study explores deep learning surrogate models for accurate stress prediction with limited data. A neural network was pre-trained on standard implant simulations (N = 3000) and adapted to narrow-diameter implants in atrophic bone (N = 200). Negative transfer occurred with extremely limited data (N = 20) due to biomechanical domain shift. However, both transfer learning and standard training achieved high accuracy at N ≥ 60 (R² = 0.94). This framework enables rapid, data-efficient biomechanical prediction for dental implant modeling.

abstract: [Public health challenges] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly reshaping healthcare globally and may offer opportunities to strengthen health systems in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), including Cambodia. AI-enabled technologies, including machine learning, deep learning, predictive analytics, computer vision, wearable devices, and generative AI, could help address persistent health-system challenges such as shortages and maldistribution of healthcare professionals, limited specialist services, unequal access to care, and constrained resources, particularly in rural and underserved communities. However, translating these technological opportunities into meaningful health benefits requires more than access to AI tools. Cambodia faces important barriers related to digital infrastructure, health-information systems, data quality and availability, workforce capacity, cybersecurity, algorithmic bias, affordability, and regulatory and ethical governance. At the same time, ongoing digital transformation, the expansion of electronic health information systems, emerging AI research capacity, and national efforts toward AI governance provide an evolving foundation for responsible adoption. This perspective examines the current and potential role of AI in Cambodia's healthcare system, focusing on applications in disease diagnosis, clinical decision support, telemedicine, public health surveillance, healthcare administration, and health-system management. Particular attention is given to the gap between technological feasibility and sustainable health-system implementation, including local validation, interoperability, economic evaluation, workforce preparedness, and long-term financing. AI should therefore be introduced through a phased, evidence-based, and patient-centered approach in which technology complements rather than replaces healthcare professionals. Investments in digital infrastructure, human capacity, locally relevant research, ethical governance, and sustainable implementation will be essential to ensure that AI contributes to improved healthcare access, quality, equity, and patient outcomes in Cambodia.
zh_abstract: [公共卫生挑战] 人工智能（AI）正日益重塑全球医疗健康，并可能为加强包括柬埔寨在内的低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的卫生系统提供机遇。包括机器学习、深度学习、预测分析、计算机视觉、可穿戴设备和生成式 AI 在内的 AI 赋能技术，有助于应对长期存在的卫生系统挑战，如医疗专业人员短缺和分布不均、专科服务有限、医疗可及性不平等以及资源受限，尤其是在农村和服务不足的社区。然而，要将这些技术机遇转化为切实的健康获益，需要的不仅仅是获得 AI 工具。柬埔寨面临着与数字基础设施、卫生信息系统、数据质量与可得性、人力资源能力、网络安全、算法偏倚、可负担性以及监管和伦理治理相关的重要障碍。与此同时，持续推进的数字化转型、电子健康信息系统的扩展、新兴的 AI 研究能力以及国家层面在 AI 治理方面的努力，为负责任地采用 AI 提供了不断发展的基础。本观点文章探讨了 AI 在柬埔寨医疗体系中的现状和潜在作用，重点关注其在疾病诊断、临床决策支持、远程医疗、公共卫生监测、医疗管理和卫生系统管理中的应用。文章特别关注技术可行性与可持续的卫生系统实施之间的差距，包括本地验证、互操作性、经济学评价、人力资源准备和长期筹资。因此，AI 的引入应采取分阶段、循证且以患者为中心的方式，使技术补充而非取代医疗专业人员。对数字基础设施、人力资源能力、本地相关研究、伦理治理和可持续实施的投入，对于确保 AI 有助于改善柬埔寨的医疗可及性、质量、公平性和患者结局至关重要。

abstract: [Primary health care research & development] The rapid adoption of AI tools in academic research has created uncertainty about appropriate use in manuscript preparation, particularly in primary health care where clear guidance is essential for maintaining research integrity across diverse settings. This review aimed to assess the availability and content of AI policies across primary health care journals and their publishers. We identified primary health care journals through searches of SCImago Journal & Country Rank, Google Scholar, and a Google search. After screening for English language, functioning webpages, recent publications, and exclusion of predatory journals, 41 journals were included. Two reviewers independently reviewed journal homepages, author guidelines, submission policies, and editorial policies for AI-related statements at both journal and publisher levels between 18 and 21 July 2025. Of 41 journals assessed, 33 (80.5%) had publicly available AI policies - 21 (51.2%) at journal level and 12 (29.3%) at publisher level. Eight journals (19.5%) had no identifiable public AI policy. All identified policies were permissive toward AI use but varied in requirements across five key areas: disclosure of AI use, acceptable AI tasks, AI authorship considerations, author responsibility, and peer review guidelines. While most primary health care journals have established AI policies, significant gaps remain in accessibility and standardization. The fragmented governance landscape, characterized by inconsistent policy locations and requirements, creates confusion for authors and might compromise research integrity. Standardized, easily accessible AI policies are needed to enable researchers to harness AI's potential while maintaining transparency and scientific rigour essential to primary health care research.
zh_abstract: [初级卫生保健研究与发展] AI工具在学术研究中的迅速普及，使得稿件撰写中如何恰当使用AI变得不确定，尤其是在初级卫生保健领域，明确的指引对于在不同环境中维护研究诚信至关重要。本综述旨在评估初级卫生保健期刊及其出版商AI政策的可得性和内容。我们通过检索SCImago Journal & Country Rank、Google Scholar和Google搜索来识别初级卫生保健期刊。在筛选英文、网页可正常访问、近期有发表，并排除掠夺性期刊后，共纳入41种期刊。两名评审员于2025年7月18日至21日独立查阅期刊主页、作者指南、投稿政策和编辑政策，检索期刊和出版商层面与AI相关的声明。在评估的41种期刊中，33种（80.5%）有公开可得的AI政策——其中期刊层面21种（51.2%），出版商层面12种（29.3%）。8种期刊（19.5%）没有可识别的公开AI政策。所有已识别的政策对AI使用均持允许态度，但在五个关键方面的要求各不相同：AI使用的披露、可接受的AI任务、AI作者身份的考量、作者责任以及同行评审指南。尽管大多数初级卫生保健期刊已制定AI政策，但在可获取性和标准化方面仍存在显著差距。政策位置和要求不一致所造成的碎片化治理格局，给作者带来困惑，并可能损害研究诚信。需要标准化且易于获取的AI政策，使研究者既能发挥AI的潜力，又能保持初级卫生保健研究所必需的透明度和科学严谨性。

title: Artificial intelligence in upper-limb, language and cognitive neurorehabilitation after stroke.
zh_title: 卒中后上肢、语言与认知神经康复中的人工智能
summary: 综述AI在卒中后三类神经康复中的研究进展，指出其在评估、个性化与可及性方面有潜力，但尚未证明临床效用优于其他数字康复方法。
key_points: AI有望增强评估、个性化康复并扩大可及性
尚未证明优于其他数字康复方法
存在数据集小、隐私公平与可持续落地问题
reason: 泛泛综述/观点类，信息增量有限
abstract: [Current opinion in neurology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is being increasingly integrated into upper-limb, language and cognitive neurorehabilitation research and there is interest in where the research currently lies along the pipeline towards clinical implementation and real-world impact. Across these three domains of neurorehabilitation, the research into the use of AI has shown clear potential to enhance assessment, personalize rehabilitation and extend access to care but is yet to demonstrate clinical utility and superiority over other digital rehabilitation approaches. There remain concerns about small and selective datasets being used for modelling, privacy and equity issues and sustainable implementation. It is suggested that AI should be positioned as an important tool in the clinical infrastructure rather than an autonomous clinical decision maker within clinical practice. Future research across these neurorehabilitation domains should consider implementation risks and needs early in the research pipeline, by using ethical principles and guidelines to ensure transparency and consumer involvement in AI research and implementation into clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Current opinion in neurology] 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地融入上肢、语言和认知神经康复研究，人们关注当前研究在通往临床实施和现实世界影响的路径中处于何种位置。在这三个神经康复领域中，关于AI应用的研究已显示出增强评估、实现康复个体化和扩大医疗可及性的明确潜力，但尚未证明其临床效用，也未证明其优于其他数字康复方法。对于建模所用数据集规模小且具选择性、隐私和公平性问题以及可持续实施，仍存在担忧。有观点建议，在临床实践中应将AI定位为临床基础设施中的重要工具，而非自主的临床决策者。这些神经康复领域未来的研究应在研究路径早期就考虑实施风险和需求，运用伦理原则和指南，确保AI研究及其在临床实践中的实施具有透明度并有使用者参与。

title: Deep learning for non-transvenous ICD screening: tailored neural network architectures, extended experiments, and explainability
zh_title: 非经静脉ICD筛查的深度学习：定制网络、扩展实验与可解释性
summary: 提出24小时动态心电筛查框架及AmpRatioNet一维卷积网络，用于S-ICD与EV-ICD的T:R、P:R比值预测，称首次开展EV-ICD队列T:R分析。
key_points: 面向S-ICD和EV-ICD的24小时筛查框架
AmpRatioNet直接处理ECG信号
首次完整评估P:R预测（作者声称）
reason: 预印本，摘要未见外部验证，方法增量
abstract: This paper studies two non-transvenous implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), namely the Subcutaneous ICD (S-ICD) and the Extravascular ICD (EV-ICD). Both avoid the complications of transvenous leads but are prone to oversensing, which can trigger inappropriate shocks associated with increased mortality. Oversensing risk is predicted by the ratio of T- or P-wave amplitude to R-wave amplitude (T:R, P:R), and these ratios vary over a 24-hour period. Yet S-ICD screening uses a single 10-second electrocardiogram (ECG) segment, and the EV-ICD has no formal screening protocol whatsoever. We present a 24-hour ambulatory screening framework for both devices which includes the first T:R analysis in an EV-ICD cohort and the first full evaluation of P:R prediction. We introduce AmpRatioNet, a family of 1D convolutional neural network architectures operating directly on the ECG signal, and benchmark it against the best existing approach - based on 2D phase space reconstruction images. Evaluation uses 4,605 clinician-annotated 10-second segments from 89 patients, with patient-level 10-fold cross-validation and bootstrap confidence intervals. AmpRatioNet-SE demonstrates superior performance on every metric in each setting with no device- or ratio-specific redesign. An explainability analysis against interpretable classical peak labelling algorithms shows that AmpRatioNet-SE's increase in error on oversensing-prone segments is up to 14 times smaller than theirs. Segment-level predictions are aggregated into a 24-hour timeline, extending S-ICD screening beyond 10 seconds and offering a plausible EV-ICD screening pathway pending device-level validation.
zh_abstract: 本文研究两种非经静脉植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD），即皮下ICD（S-ICD）和血管外ICD（EV-ICD）。二者均可避免经静脉电极导线的并发症，但易发生感知过度，进而可能触发与死亡率增加相关的不恰当电击。感知过度的风险可通过T波或P波振幅与R波振幅之比（T:R、P:R）进行预测，而这些比值在24小时内会发生变化。然而，S-ICD筛查仅使用单个10秒心电图（ECG）片段，而EV-ICD则完全没有正式的筛查方案。我们提出了一种适用于两种装置的24小时动态筛查框架，其中包括首次在EV-ICD队列中进行的T:R分析以及首次对P:R预测的全面评估。我们提出了AmpRatioNet，这是一类直接作用于ECG信号的一维卷积神经网络架构，并将其与现有最佳方法（基于二维相空间重构图像）进行比较。评估使用来自89例患者的4,605个经临床医生标注的10秒片段，采用患者水平的10折交叉验证和bootstrap置信区间。AmpRatioNet-SE在每种设置下的各项指标上均表现更优，且无需针对装置或比值进行专门的重新设计。与可解释的经典峰值标注算法相比，可解释性分析显示AmpRatioNet-SE在易发生感知过度的片段上的误差增幅最多比它们小14倍。片段水平的预测被汇总为24小时时间线，将S-ICD筛查延伸至10秒以上，并在待装置层面验证的前提下为EV-ICD提供了一条可行的筛查途径。

title: Vision Tomography: Towards Portable 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Inference from Visual Data
zh_title: 视觉断层成像：从视觉数据双向推断三维面部与颅骨
summary: 预印本提出Vision Tomography框架，从多种视觉模态重建成对的三维面部与颅骨几何，并支持联合编辑，构建了200余例CT配对数据集。
key_points: 提出便携、无辐射的颅骨几何获取思路
构建含CT颅骨、CT面部与纹理扫描的200余例数据集
提出稠密射线匹配配准方法
reason: 新颖方法预印本，数据集小，缺少临床验证
abstract: Traditional computed tomography (CT) can capture paired 3D face and skull geometry, but it remains costly, fixed in location, and exposes patients to radiation. For applications such as remote diagnostics, digital healthcare, forensic identification, missing-person investigation, and archaeological analysis, there is an urgent need for a portable, safe, and accessible solution to capture 3D skull geometry. In this work, we introduce Vision Tomography (VT), a concept and framework capable of reconstructing paired 3D face-skull geometry from various visual modalities, and also enabling joint manipulation of 3D facial and skull geometry. To achieve this, we first construct a dataset of over 200 samples, where each case includes a CT-based skull, a CT-based face, and a high-fidelity textured face scan. Secondly, we propose a novel dense ray matching registration method that ensures topological consistency across face, skull, and their tissue correspondences. Building on this registration, we introduce the 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Morphable Model (BFSM) as the foundation of Vision Tomography, which enables shape inference between the face and skull through a shared coefficient space, while also modeling tissue thickness variation to support one-to-many facial reconstructions from the same skull, reflecting individual facial changes such as age or body fat. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of Vision Tomography across various forensic and medical applications, including paired 3D face-skull reconstruction from images or sketches and predicting surgical outcomes with joint face-skull editing. Extensive experiments confirm the robustness and accuracy of our method. Vision Tomography is available at https://github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM
zh_abstract: 传统计算机断层扫描（CT）可以获取成对的三维面部与颅骨几何结构，但其成本高昂、位置固定，并使患者暴露于辐射之下。对于远程诊断、数字医疗、法医身份识别、失踪人员调查和考古分析等应用，迫切需要一种便携、安全且易于获得的三维颅骨几何获取方案。在本工作中，我们提出了视觉断层成像（Vision Tomography，VT），这是一种能够从多种视觉模态重建成对三维面部-颅骨几何结构、并支持对三维面部和颅骨几何进行联合操控的概念与框架。为此，我们首先构建了一个包含 200 多个样本的数据集，其中每个病例包括一个基于 CT 的颅骨、一个基于 CT 的面部以及一个高保真带纹理的面部扫描。其次，我们提出了一种新颖的稠密射线匹配配准方法，可确保面部、颅骨及其组织对应关系之间的拓扑一致性。在该配准基础上，我们提出了三维双向面部-颅骨可变形模型（3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Morphable Model，BFSM）作为 Vision Tomography 的基础，该模型通过共享系数空间实现面部与颅骨之间的形状推断，同时对组织厚度变化进行建模，以支持从同一颅骨进行一对多的面部重建，从而反映年龄或体脂等个体面部变化。最后，我们展示了 Vision Tomography 在多种法医和医学应用中的有效性，包括从图像或草图重建成对三维面部-颅骨，以及通过面部-颅骨联合编辑预测手术效果。大量实验证实了我们方法的稳健性和准确性。Vision Tomography 可在 https://github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM 获取。

title: Algorithmic Bias from the Perspectives of Healthcare Professionals
zh_title: 医疗从业者视角下的算法偏见
summary: 基于对医疗专业人员的问卷与访谈，研究算法偏见、感知公平与对机器学习算法接受/采用意愿之间的关系，发现看法因岗位角色等而异。
key_points: 问卷与访谈覆盖临床与行政等不同岗位
偏见成因、评估标准与缓解方式的看法因角色而异
作者指出仍需更多研究以保障公平
reason: 预印本，调查类研究，样本与验证信息有限，属增量档
abstract: This paper focuses on algorithmic bias of machine learning and artificial intelligence applications in healthcare information systems. Based on the quantitative data and qualitative comments from a survey and interviews with healthcare professionals, who have different job roles (e.g., clinical vs. administrative), this study provides findings about the relationships between algorithmic bias, perceived fairness, and the intended acceptance and adoption of ML algorithms and algorithm generated outcomes. The results suggest that the opinions of healthcare professionals toward the causes of algorithmic bias, the criteria of algorithm assessment, the perceived fairness, and bias mitigation approaches may vary depending on their job roles, perspectives, tasks, and the algorithm characteristics. More research is needed to investigate algorithmic bias to ensure fairness and equality in healthcare.
zh_abstract: 本文关注医疗信息系统中机器学习和人工智能应用的算法偏倚。基于对不同岗位角色（如临床与行政）的医疗专业人员进行的调查和访谈所得的定量数据和定性意见，本研究给出了算法偏倚、感知公平性与对机器学习算法及算法生成结果的预期接受和采纳之间关系的研究发现。结果表明，医疗专业人员对算法偏倚的成因、算法评估标准、感知公平性及偏倚缓解方法的看法，可能因其岗位角色、视角、任务以及算法特征而异。需要开展更多研究来探讨算法偏倚，以确保医疗中的公平与平等。

title: CARF: Context-Aware Reasoning Supervision for Scientific Evidence Screening
zh_title: CARF：面向科学证据筛选的上下文感知推理监督
summary: 提出人在回路框架CARF，利用专家对模型推理的反馈，使语言模型适应系统综述标题摘要筛选；在死因判定方法综述上表现有竞争力且保持高敏感度。
key_points: 专家反馈模型生成的推理以适配语境
评估对象为死因/口头尸检系统综述
筛选性能有竞争力并保持高敏感度
reason: 新方法预印本，领域较窄，证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Systematic reviews synthesize biomedical evidence to inform clinical and public-health decision-making, but require domain experts to manually screen thousands of studies against detailed eligibility criteria. We investigate whether language models can assist with this bottleneck by learning from expert feedback on title and abstract screening decisions and model-generated reasoning. We introduce the Context-Aware Reasoning Framework (CARF), a human-in-the-loop framework that uses expert feedback on model-generated reasoning to adapt language models to context-dependent screening tasks. We evaluate CARF on systematic reviews of verbal autopsy and cause-of-death ascertainment methods used in global public health mortality surveillance. CARF shows competitive screening performance compared to evaluated models while retaining high sensitivity, and is more inclined to retain ambiguous, context-dependent studies for human review. Together, these findings suggest that expert-corrected reasoning is a promising supervision signal for context-dependent scientific screening, while retaining a role for human oversight.

title: Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups
zh_title: 医学影像负责任量子机器学习：跨敏感亚组的公平性审计
summary: 在皮肤病变(DDI)与胸片(CheXpert)上审计经典与量子分类器的亚组公平性，并测试多种缓解方法，PanDerm、EVA-X作外部参照。
key_points: 比较SVM、MLP、QSVM、QCNN
测试EO正则、梯度反转等缓解
量子分类器总体有竞争力但仍存亚组差异
reason: 公平性审计有新意但为预印本，量子方法实用性有限
abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities. Since a smaller subgroup AUC gap may stem from degrading the best group rather than improving the worst, each mitigation is also tested against a pre-specified non-inferiority margin relative to its baseline. Under this criterion, several configurations with the smallest disparity, notably QCNN with GRL on DDI, are not clinically acceptable due to loss of global discrimination. On DDI, QSVM with GRL+EO performed best and approached PanDerm in the performance/fairness trade-off; on CheXpert, QCNN with GRL achieved the highest aggregate performance but increased disparity, and EVA-X remained stronger. Fairness effects are model- and dataset-dependent, so QML requires empirical subgroup-aware evaluation. All quantum models run in classical simulation; we claim no quantum advantage.
zh_abstract: 量子机器学习（QML）在医学分类中的探索日益增多，但其在亚组感知公平性标准下的表现仍研究不足。我们在假设QML并非天然公平的前提下，对用于医学影像的经典与量子分类器开展了实证公平性审计。评估了两种场景：DDI数据集上的皮肤病变（敏感属性：Fitzpatrick皮肤类型）和基于CheXpert的数据上的胸部X线（敏感属性：年龄组）。基于ResNet-18嵌入，我们在基线及三种缓解设置下训练SVM、MLP、QSVM和QCNN：可微分均等化几率（EO）正则化、梯度反转学习（GRL）以及二者联合。基础模型（PanDerm、EVA-X）作为外部参照。量子分类器可能取得具有竞争力的总体性能，但仍存在亚组差异。由于较小的亚组AUC差距可能源于降低最优组的表现而非改善最差组，每种缓解方法还相对于其基线，针对预先设定的非劣效性界值进行了检验。在该标准下，若干差异最小的配置（尤其是DDI上采用GRL的QCNN）因整体判别能力下降而在临床上不可接受。在DDI上，采用GRL+EO的QSVM表现最佳，在性能/公平性权衡方面接近PanDerm；在CheXpert上，采用GRL的QCNN取得最高的总体性能，但差异增大，而EVA-X仍更强。公平性效应取决于模型和数据集，因此QML需要经验性的亚组感知评估。所有量子模型均在经典模拟中运行；我们不主张存在量子优势。

title: Benchmarking decision models against generative large language models on medical multiple-choice questions
zh_title: 决策模型与生成式大模型在医学选择题上的基准比较
summary: 在1273道MedQA四选一题上比较13个决策模型与15种生成式LLM配置，生成式配置准确率更高，决策模型在成本和延迟上有优势。
key_points: 高置信答案仍有1.71%–12.77%错误
reason: 选择题基准比较，无临床验证，预印本，增量档
abstract: Medical workflows often require selecting among predefined options. We compared 13 decision models with 15 generative large language model configurations, including different reasoning settings, using 1,273 four-option MedQA questions under text-only conditions. Accuracy ranged from 67.71% to 89.08% for decision models and from 78.32% to 96.86% for generative configurations. Among the tested configurations, Mercury Decide had the lowest mean final-attempt cost (USD 0.0069 per 1,000 questions), while Clef Omni had the shortest median request duration (0.291 seconds). Decision-model probabilities distinguished correct from incorrect answers, but error rates among answers assigned probabilities of at least 0.90 ranged from 1.71% to 12.77%. Answer agreement across three runs ranged from 92.30% to 100%, while probability repeatability varied. Decision models offered resource advantages alongside lower peak accuracy; selecting models for medical workflows requires considering probability quality and repeatability together with accuracy and the resources needed to detect and correct errors.
zh_abstract: 医疗工作流程常常需要在预设选项中进行选择。我们在纯文本条件下，使用1,273道四选一MedQA题目，比较了13个决策模型与15种生成式大语言模型配置（包括不同的推理设置）。决策模型的准确率为67.71%至89.08%，生成式配置的准确率为78.32%至96.86%。在所测试的配置中，Mercury Decide的平均末次尝试成本最低（每1,000道题0.0069美元），Clef Omni的请求耗时中位数最短（0.291秒）。决策模型的概率可区分正确与错误答案，但在被赋予至少0.90概率的答案中，错误率为1.71%至12.77%。三次运行间的答案一致性为92.30%至100%，而概率的可重复性各不相同。决策模型在资源方面具有优势，但峰值准确率较低；为医疗工作流程选择模型时，需要将概率质量和可重复性，与准确率以及发现和纠正错误所需的资源一并考虑。

title: LLMs as Judges and Examinees for Medical Item Difficulty Prediction
zh_title: 以LLM为评判者与模拟考生预测医学试题难度
summary: 利用开源LLM在USMLE与PANCE试题上的难度评分及作答信号（正确性、概率、熵等），结合基线特征预测题目难度。
key_points: LLM分别担任难度评判者与模拟考生
提取正确性、选项概率、熵、概率间隔等信号
与基线题目特征结合用于下游预测
reason: 医学教育方向的预印本方法，证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Predicting medical item difficulty from item text alone remains challenging. Prior work has largely relied on linguistic features or text representations derived from general-purpose and domain-specific language models, but predictive performance has remained modest. This study takes a different approach by using difficulty-related signals that emerge when open-weight large language models (LLMs) interact with test items. Using USMLE and PANCE medical licensure examination items, we examined LLMs in two roles. As judges, the models provided absolute difficulty ratings and pairwise difficulty comparisons. As simulated examinees, they generated response-based signals including correctness, keyed-option probability, response entropy, and the probability margin between the top two options. We then combined the strongest judgment and response signals with baseline item features in downstream prediction models. Pairwise difficulty judgment was the most consistent individual LLM signal across both datasets, while simulated-examinee signals and absolute judgments provided complementary information in some feature combinations. The best configurations reached a Spearman correlation of $ρ$ = .447 on USMLE, exceeding the best system in the 2024 BEA shared task ($ρ$ = .25), and $ρ$ = .494 on PANCE. These results were comparable to direct absolute judgments from the proprietary frontier model Claude Opus 5 ($ρ$ = .443 and .488, respectively). Overall, judgment and response signals from open-weight LLMs captured difficulty-related information beyond text representations. Because these models can be deployed locally, the approach offers a practical option for predicting the difficulty of unreleased or high-security test items.

title: Convex Potential Learning for Optimal Transport Between Medical Images
zh_title: 医学图像间最优传输的凸势函数学习
summary: 通过参数化凸势函数估计最优传输映射，保证无旋，在2D与3D医学影像数据集上传输误差更低、重建质量更高。
key_points: 参数化凸势函数，符合Brenier定理
映射构造上保证无旋

abstract: Computing optimal transport maps between medical images plays a fundamental role in morphological analysis. However, existing methods are either difficult to scale to large 3D medical images or rely on regularized formulations that provide only approximate transport maps. To improve the accuracy of downstream medical image analysis, we propose a novel approach for estimating optimal transport maps by parameterizing the convex potential function. By construction, the resulting transport map is guaranteed to be curl-free, consistent with Brenier's theorem. We evaluate the proposed method on both 2D and 3D medical imaging datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves lower transport estimation errors and produces higher-quality image reconstructions than existing methods.
zh_abstract: 计算医学图像之间的最优传输映射在形态学分析中具有基础性作用。然而，现有方法要么难以扩展到大型三维医学图像，要么依赖仅能提供近似传输映射的正则化形式。为提高下游医学图像分析的准确性，我们提出了一种通过对凸势函数进行参数化来估计最优传输映射的新方法。按照构造，所得传输映射保证无旋（curl-free），与 Brenier 定理一致。我们在二维和三维医学影像数据集上评估了所提方法。实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，我们的方法传输估计误差更低，并能生成质量更高的图像重建结果。

title: Meta-Initialization of Implicit Neural Representations to Accelerate Deformable Medical Image Registration
zh_title: 隐式神经表示元初始化加速可变形医学图像配准
summary: 研究用Reptile和STRAINER初始化加速基于INR的可变形配准，在OASIS-1上提升早期适应的Dice与HD95。

OASIS-1：364对训练、49对测试
迭代1500时Dice更高、HD95更低

abstract: Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. This work investigates whether early adaptation can be accelerated using an initialization learned from a collection of previously solved registration tasks. We examine two schemes: Reptile meta-initialization and STRAINER transfer of the shared component of a coordinate network. KAN-IDIR is used as the base INR displacement-field model. Experiments are conducted on OASIS-1, with 364 consecutive pairs used for training and 49 pairs for test-time adaptation. Registration quality is evaluated using mean Dice and HD95, together with the fraction of voxels with a negative Jacobian determinant at iteration 1500. In the configurations studied, both schemes yield higher Dice and lower HD95 at early iterations than random initialization. Reptile numerically outperforms STRAINER under a small iteration budget, although their pretraining budgets are not matched. As the number of iterations increases, the differences between the schemes shrink. STRAINER pretraining takes 39-40 minutes, compared with 44.98 hours for Reptile.
zh_abstract: 用于可变形医学图像配准的隐式神经表示（INR）方法需要针对每一对新图像优化网络参数，因此适应速度成为实际应用中的限制。本研究探讨能否利用从一组已解决的配准任务中学得的初始化来加速早期适应。我们考察了两种方案：Reptile 元初始化，以及对坐标网络共享部分进行迁移的 STRAINER。KAN-IDIR 被用作基础 INR 位移场模型。实验在 OASIS-1 上进行，使用 364 个连续图像对进行训练，49 个图像对用于测试时适应。配准质量以平均 Dice 和 HD95 评估，并在第 1500 次迭代时评估雅可比行列式为负的体素所占比例。在所研究的配置中，两种方案在早期迭代时均比随机初始化获得更高的 Dice 和更低的 HD95。在较小的迭代预算下，Reptile 在数值上优于 STRAINER，尽管二者的预训练预算并不匹配。随着迭代次数增加，各方案之间的差异缩小。STRAINER 预训练耗时 39–40 分钟，而 Reptile 为 44.98 小时。

title: Using iterative agentic retrieval-augmented generation to refine the risk of infection from social contexts during the COVID-19 pandemic: Development and Evaluation Study

key_points: LSTM基于19,434条社交互动文本

abstract: Background: Contact tracing is crucial to limit pathogen transmission and to gather epidemiological data. However, despite machine learning optimizations, it remains time-consuming. Large language models have been used for infection risk prediction, but no existing application converses with a user to adapt its risk estimates. Objective: We aimed to develop an iterative retrieval-augmented generation conversational framework to predict coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) infection risk from textual social data. The conversational agent aims to gather personalized risk factors based on descriptions of social interactions. Methods: We trained a long short-term memory (LSTM) model to predict the risk of COVID-19 infection from 19,434 textual descriptions of social interactions, collected during the pandemic in the Leuven student community, in Belgium. We integrated this model into a Llama3.3-based conversational framework that iteratively gathers additional social information that may represent a risk of infection. We evaluated the framework using large language model (LLM)-as-a-judge metrics and by comparing its risk assessment in different social contexts. Results: Based solely on social interaction data, a fine-tuned RobBERT model predicted infection risk with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC AUC) of 0.73. It performed similarly to an LSTM model and a logistic regression on term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) features, which both achieved a ROC AUC of 0.72. These three models slightly outperformed a Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA)-fine-tuned Mistral NeMo model (ROC AUC = 0.69). Llama3.3 performed well in our framework: the predicted infection risk converged often, and it asked fewer redundant questions than the smaller models (Mistral 7B, Gemma3 12B). In addition, the framework showed the ability to stratify, by risk of infection, synthetic users who had different types of social interactions. Conclusions: Combining simple language models with large language models can refine individual infection risk from contact tracing data in a high-circulation context. Our conversational framework may help optimize contact tracing by highlighting social contexts with a high risk of infection.
zh_abstract: 【背景】接触者追踪对于限制病原体传播和收集流行病学数据至关重要。然而，尽管有机器学习优化，其仍然耗时。大语言模型已被用于感染风险预测，但尚无现有应用能够与用户对话以调整其风险估计。【目的】我们旨在开发一种迭代式检索增强生成对话框架，从文本社交数据中预测2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）感染风险。该对话智能体旨在根据对社交互动的描述收集个性化风险因素。【方法】我们训练了一个长短期记忆（LSTM）模型，根据19,434条社交互动文本描述预测COVID-19感染风险，这些描述采集于大流行期间比利时鲁汶学生群体。我们将该模型整合到基于Llama3.3的对话框架中，该框架迭代地收集可能代表感染风险的额外社交信息。我们使用大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者的指标，并通过比较其在不同社交情境下的风险评估来评价该框架。【结果】仅基于社交互动数据，经微调的RobBERT模型预测感染风险的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC AUC）为0.73。其表现与LSTM模型以及基于词频-逆文档频率（TF-IDF）特征的逻辑回归相近，后两者的ROC AUC均为0.72。这三种模型略优于经量化低秩适配（QLoRA）微调的Mistral NeMo模型（ROC AUC = 0.69）。Llama3.3在我们的框架中表现良好：预测的感染风险经常收敛，且其提出的冗余问题少于较小的模型（Mistral 7B、Gemma3 12B）。此外，该框架显示出能够按感染风险对具有不同类型社交互动的合成用户进行分层。【结论】在高传播背景下，将简单语言模型与大语言模型相结合，可以根据接触者追踪数据细化个体感染风险。我们的对话框架可通过突出感染风险高的社交情境，帮助优化接触者追踪。

title: Coach-BP: Computer Vision-Based Assessment and Correction of Blood Pressure Measurement Technique
zh_title: Coach-BP：基于计算机视觉评估并纠正血压测量操作
summary: Coach-BP用视频检测血压测量技术错误，在225名参与者的408次测量中以留一参与者交叉验证对照专家评分评估。
key_points: 依据AHA五项标准评估测量姿势等技术

abstract: Background: Accurate blood pressure (BP) measurement, essential for hypertension care, requires proper technique. Posture errors can raise systolic BP by more than 20 mm Hg, yet technique is rarely verified objectively. We aimed to develop and evaluate Coach-BP, a computer vision system that detects technique errors from video to support real-time coaching. Methods: We enrolled adults attending an academic cardiovascular prevention center between February and April 2026 and filmed BP measurements with front and side cameras. We analyzed 408 encounters from 225 participants. Coach-BP uses machine learning models trained on clinician labels to assess five American Heart Association criteria using pose, visual context, and audio-visual features. We evaluated its accuracy against expert clinician ratings by leave-one-participant-out cross-validation. We then examined robustness to simulated camera artifacts and interpreted the features important for each criterion. Findings: At baseline, 138 (62%) of 223 participants had at least one technique error and 54 (24%) two or more. Coach-BP achieved a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.93 (95% CI 0.90-0.94), with 0.97 (0.94-0.99) for legs uncrossed, 0.97 (0.93-1.00) for no talking, 0.92 (0.85-0.98) for back supported, 0.91 (0.86-0.95) for feet flat, and 0.86 (0.81-0.91) for arm supported at heart level. Mean balanced accuracy was 0.88 (0.85-0.90). Performance was robust to simulated camera shift, zoom, and rotation. Its models relied on features clinicians would assess, such as cuffed-hand height and foot position. One model classified back support similarly from either camera. Interpretation: Coach-BP accurately detected errors in the five guideline-recommended criteria of BP measurement technique from clinic video, enabling objective assessment of each criterion.
zh_abstract:
【背景】准确的血压（BP）测量对高血压诊疗至关重要，需要正确的操作技术。姿势错误可使收缩压升高超过20 mm Hg，但操作技术很少得到客观核查。我们旨在开发并评估 Coach-BP，这是一种通过视频检测操作技术错误以支持实时指导的计算机视觉系统。
【方法】我们纳入2026年2月至4月期间在一家学术性心血管预防中心就诊的成年人，并使用前侧两个摄像头拍摄血压测量过程。我们分析了来自225名参与者的408次测量过程。Coach-BP 使用基于临床医生标注训练的机器学习模型，利用姿态、视觉情境以及视听特征评估美国心脏协会的五项标准。我们通过留一参与者交叉验证，以专家临床医生评分为参照评估其准确性。随后检验了其对模拟摄像头伪影的稳健性，并解释了各项标准的重要特征。
【结果】基线时，223名参与者中有138名（62%）至少存在一项技术错误，54名（24%）存在两项或以上。Coach-BP 的受试者操作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）平均为0.93（95% CI 0.90-0.94），其中不交叉双腿为0.97（0.94-0.99），不说话为0.97（0.93-1.00），背部有支撑为0.92（0.85-0.98），双脚平放为0.91（0.86-0.95），手臂支撑于心脏水平为0.86（0.81-0.91）。平均平衡准确率为0.88（0.85-0.90）。在模拟摄像头移位、缩放和旋转下性能保持稳健。其模型依赖于临床医生会评估的特征，如袖带侧手的高度和脚的位置。一个模型对背部支撑的分类在任一摄像头下均相似。
【结论】Coach-BP 能够从门诊视频中准确检测血压测量技术中五项指南推荐标准的错误，从而可对每项标准进行客观评估。

title: An Agentic AI Pipeline for an Evidence-Grounded Environmental Health Public Information System: Development and Evaluation

abstract: Background: Existing environmental and health information systems typically provide isolated data streams, requiring users to interpret heterogeneous information sources without personalized guidance. Residents and health providers of urban regions with complex environmental conditions, such as the Salt Lake Valley, frequently seek timely, location-specific information about weather, air quality, and their associated health impacts, but may find it difficult to integrate this information in their decision-making, precluding the effective translation of valuable environmental health information into action. Objective: This study aimed to develop and evaluate an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) pipeline that delivers evidence-grounded, neighborhood-scale responses to health-related environmental questions raised lay persons by dynamically orchestrating authoritative weather, neighborhood-scale environmental observations, air quality, and health-evidence resources. Methods: We developed an agentic AI pipeline using LangGraph and OpenAI large language models to interpret natural language queries, select and invoke relevant external tools, retrieve real-time environmental data and evidence-based health guidance, and synthesize responses. The pipeline integrates multiple authoritative resources, including weather forecasts, air-quality observations, geospatial services, and a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) module built from asthma-related clinical guidance. The system incorporates fallback mechanisms to improve robustness when external services are unavailable. We evaluated the pipeline using a curated benchmark of representative user questions, assessing tool-needed recognition, correct tool selection, avoidance of irrelevant tools, parameter mapping, analytic pathway selection, and incorporation of tool outputs into the final response. Results: The developed system successfully integrated heterogeneous environmental and health information sources into a unified conversational interface that produces evidence-grounded, neighborhood-scale responses for the Salt Lake Valley. Evaluation demonstrated generally strong tool recognition, parameter mapping, and incorporation of retrieved information across diverse question types, supporting the pipeline's ability to retrieve and integrate authoritative environmental and health information consumable by lay persons and providing an important step for the T3 and T4 phases of the translational pipeline of exposu
zh_abstract: 【背景】现有的环境与健康信息系统通常只提供彼此孤立的数据流，用户需要在缺乏个性化指导的情况下自行解读异构的信息来源。在盐湖谷（Salt Lake Valley）等环境条件复杂的城市地区，居民和健康服务提供者经常需要及时获取特定地点的天气、空气质量及其相关健康影响的信息，但可能难以将这些信息整合用于决策，从而妨碍了有价值的环境健康信息转化为行动。【目的】本研究旨在开发并评估一种具有自主代理能力的人工智能（agentic AI）流程，通过动态调用权威的天气、邻里尺度环境观测、空气质量和健康证据资源，为非专业人士提出的与健康相关的环境问题提供有证据依据的、邻里尺度的回答。【方法】我们使用 LangGraph 和 OpenAI 大语言模型开发了一个 agentic AI 流程，用于理解自然语言查询、选择并调用相关外部工具、检索实时环境数据和循证健康指导，并综合生成回答。该流程整合了多种权威资源，包括天气预报、空气质量观测、地理空间服务，以及基于哮喘相关临床指南构建的检索增强生成（RAG）模块。系统设有回退机制，以在外部服务不可用时提高稳健性。我们使用一组经过整理的代表性用户问题基准对该流程进行评估，评估内容包括工具需求识别、正确的工具选择、避免调用无关工具、参数映射、分析路径选择，以及将工具输出纳入最终回答的情况。【结果】所开发的系统成功将异构的环境和健康信息来源整合到统一的对话界面中，可为盐湖谷生成有证据依据的邻里尺度回答。评估显示，在不同类型的问题上，系统总体上具有较强的工具识别、参数映射和检索信息整合能力，支持该流程检索并整合可供非专业人士使用的权威环境与健康信息，并为暴露研究转化流程的 T3 和 T4 阶段迈出了重要一步。（原文摘要在此处中断。）

abstract: [Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease] Bacterial infections remain a major global health challenge, which are responsible for significant morbidity, mortality, and increasing antimicrobial resistance worldwide. Rapid and accurate identification of bacterial pathogens is therefore essential for guiding appropriate antimicrobial therapy, improving patient outcomes, and supporting effective infection control strategies. However, conventional microbiological diagnostic methods such as culture, microscopy, and biochemical testing are often time-consuming, labor-intensive, and dependent on expert interpretation. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly emerged as a powerful tool capable of transforming clinical microbiology by enabling rapid analysis of complex biomedical data. This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the role of AI in the diagnosis and identification of bacterial pathogens and to discuss its current applications, advantages, limitations, and future perspectives. Key AI-assisted technologies, including machine learning and deep learning algorithms such as Random Forest, Support Vector Machines, Artificial Neural Networks, and Convolutional Neural Networks, are increasingly applied to diagnostic platforms, including automated microscopy, next-generation genomic sequencing, MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry, and clinical data analysis systems. Current evidence indicates that AI-assisted diagnostic approaches can substantially improve the speed, accuracy, and automation of microbial pathogen detection while enabling large-scale analysis of microbiological and clinical datasets. In the future, AI-integrated microbiology laboratories, rapid diagnostic platforms, genomic surveillance systems, and AI-assisted clinical decision support tools are expected to further enhance infectious disease diagnostics and contribute to improved antimicrobial stewardship and global infection management.
zh_abstract: [诊断微生物学与传染病] 细菌感染仍是全球主要的健康挑战，在全球范围内造成严重的发病率和死亡率，并导致抗菌药物耐药性不断上升。因此，快速、准确地鉴定细菌病原体对于指导恰当的抗菌治疗、改善患者结局以及支持有效的感染控制策略至关重要。然而，培养、显微镜检查和生化检测等传统微生物诊断方法往往耗时、费力，并依赖专家判读。近年来，人工智能（AI）日益成为能够通过快速分析复杂生物医学数据来变革临床微生物学的有力工具。本综述旨在全面概述AI在细菌病原体诊断与鉴定中的作用，并讨论其当前应用、优势、局限性和未来前景。包括随机森林、支持向量机、人工神经网络和卷积神经网络等机器学习和深度学习算法在内的关键AI辅助技术，正日益应用于自动化显微镜、下一代基因组测序、MALDI-TOF质谱和临床数据分析系统等诊断平台。现有证据表明，AI辅助的诊断方法可显著提高微生物病原体检测的速度、准确性和自动化程度，同时能够对微生物学和临床数据集进行大规模分析。未来，整合AI的微生物实验室、快速诊断平台、基因组监测系统以及AI辅助的临床决策支持工具有望进一步提升传染病诊断水平，并有助于改善抗菌药物管理和全球感染管理。

abstract: [OTA international : the open access journal of orthopaedic trauma] Artificial Intelligence (AI) is an ascendant technical field with potential to revolutionize health care and orthopaedics. This paper highlights ways in which AI is already affecting members of the Orthopaedic Trauma Association (OTA), while identifying paths to clinical application, as presented at the 2025 OTA Annual Meeting's Basic Science Focus Forum. A report from the OTA AI Task Force shared some initial accomplishments, including the crafting of a position statement. Areas of AI application in orthopaedic trauma were discussed, including the prediction of fall risk in the elderly, capabilities for automated image-based diagnosis and outcome assessment, and efforts toward creating a framework for in silico clinical trials that rely upon virtual patient cohorts. Together these applications show how AI is emerging as a foundational tool in orthopaedic trauma research. Over the next few years, these products will be moving from the research laboratory to the clinic. For the tools to be of greatest benefit, a measured development approach using teams of data scientists partnered with orthopaedic trauma surgeons must be adopted. Academia and Industry are both progressing in this direction-the best path forward will likely involve shared development efforts. As these efforts progress, OTA members will undoubtedly be involved. Both they and their patients stand to be the primary beneficiaries of many of these developments.
zh_abstract: [OTA international：骨科创伤开放获取期刊] 人工智能（AI）是一个迅速崛起的技术领域，有可能彻底改变医疗保健和骨科。本文重点介绍了 AI 已经以何种方式影响骨科创伤学会（OTA）成员，并指出了临床应用的路径，内容源自 2025 年 OTA 年会基础科学焦点论坛的报告。OTA AI 工作组的一份报告分享了一些初步成果，包括起草了一份立场声明。会议讨论了 AI 在骨科创伤中的应用领域，包括老年人跌倒风险预测、基于影像的自动诊断和结局评估能力，以及为建立依赖虚拟患者队列的计算机模拟（in silico）临床试验框架所做的努力。这些应用共同表明，AI 正在成为骨科创伤研究中的基础性工具。未来几年，这些产品将从研究实验室走向临床。为使这些工具发挥最大效益，必须采用审慎的开发方式，由数据科学家与骨科创伤外科医生组成团队合作。学术界和产业界都在朝这一方向推进，最佳前进路径很可能涉及共同开发。随着这些工作的推进，OTA 成员无疑会参与其中。他们及其患者将成为许多此类进展的主要受益者。

title: The Reverse Native-Speaker Problem: Teaching Physiology to a Generation Fluent in Tools We Are Still Learning.

summary: 观点文章指出生成式AI解释在生理学中常逐步看似合理却在跨系统层面不一致，主张教师转向认证一致性，并提出“找错”课堂练习。

abstract: [Advances in physiology education] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping physiology education, but the central challenge is epistemic, not technological. Learners are often more fluent with AI tools than their instructors, yet less fluent in the physiology those tools describe: a pattern this Perspective terms the reverse native-speaker problem. AI-generated explanations of physiological mechanisms are rarely overtly wrong. An interpretive framework proposed by means of this perspective states that explanations that appear plausible step by step may become become inconsistent when organ systems are considered together. It is therefore argued that the educator role is shifting from transmitting information to certifying coherence and proposes a classroom exercise, the error-hunt, for identifying seeded, systems-level inconsistencies in AI-generated explanations.
zh_abstract: [Advances in physiology education] 生成式人工智能（AI）正在重塑生理学教育，但核心挑战是认识论层面的，而非技术层面的。学习者往往比其教师更熟练地使用AI工具，却对这些工具所描述的生理学不够熟练：本观点文章将这一模式称为“反向母语者问题”。AI生成的生理机制解释很少有明显错误。本观点文章提出的一个解释性框架指出，逐步看来似乎合理的解释，在综合考虑各器官系统时可能变得前后不一致。因此，文章主张教育者的角色正从传递信息转变为确证连贯性，并提出一种课堂练习“找错”（error-hunt），用于识别AI生成解释中被植入的、系统层面的不一致之处。

title: Auditable Hierarchical Inference with Multimodal Evidence and Bayesian Active Inquiry

summary: 在合成数据上评估舌象、脉象与声音多模态推断及贝叶斯主动问询框架，600例合成评估中问询将证候家族准确率由87.0%提至95.5%。
key_points: 客观多模态模型映射到八个证候家族

abstract: Most multimodal classifiers assume that all useful evidence is available upfront, whereas clinical inquiry is sequential. We present a synthetic evaluation framework separating objective multimodal inference from active inquiry. An objective model maps synthetic tongue, bilateral multipressure pulse, and acoustic observations to eight syndrome families. A provenance-bearing Knowledge Core and training-only answer model support Bayesian narrowing over 33 fine terms using 25 typed questions, while seven safety questions remain outside the diagnostic posterior. Weak shared symptom factors limit fine-term influence on objective phenotypes, and an objective-only probe tests leakage. In a preregistered 600-case synthetic evaluation, objective family accuracy was 87.0%. Cost-sensitive expected information gain (cost-EIG) raised family accuracy to 95.5% and exact fine-term accuracy to 42.5%, versus 92.7% and 33.0% for an unoptimized fixed-order baseline. Selective family accuracy reached 96.9% at 95.3% coverage. However, cost-EIG asked more questions on average than fixed order (9.795 versus 9.352). Missing-audio routing retained 94.0% family accuracy, and a workflow invariant enforced abstention when all objective modalities were absent. Permuting fine-term answer likelihoods reduced family accuracy to 78.7%. Five of six frozen checks passed, but the question-efficiency hypothesis failed. Comparisons are descriptive because only aggregate, not paired case-level, outputs were retained. These results establish a reproducible synthetic workflow, not clinical diagnostic or treatment validity.
zh_abstract: 大多数多模态分类器假定所有有用证据在一开始即可获得，而临床问诊则是循序渐进的。我们提出了一个合成评估框架，将客观多模态推断与主动问诊区分开来。一个客观模型将合成的舌象、双侧多压脉象和声学观察映射到八个证候大类。一个带有溯源信息的知识核心（Knowledge Core）和一个仅用训练数据构建的回答模型，支持利用25个分类型问题对33个细分证候术语进行贝叶斯逐步收窄，另有七个安全性问题不纳入诊断后验。弱共享症状因子限制了细分术语对客观表型的影响，并通过仅客观信息探针检验信息泄漏。在一项预先注册的600例合成评估中，客观证候大类准确率为87.0%。代价敏感的期望信息增益（cost-EIG）将证候大类准确率提高到95.5%，细分术语精确准确率提高到42.5%；而未经优化的固定顺序基线分别为92.7%和33.0%。选择性证候大类准确率在覆盖率95.3%时达到96.9%。然而，cost-EIG平均提问数多于固定顺序（9.795对9.352）。缺失音频路由保持了94.0%的证候大类准确率，并且当所有客观模态均缺失时，工作流不变量强制执行弃权。对细分术语回答似然进行置换使证候大类准确率降至78.7%。六项冻结检验中有五项通过，但提问效率假设未能成立。由于仅保留了汇总输出而非配对的病例级输出，各项比较仅为描述性的。这些结果确立了一个可复现的合成工作流，而不是临床诊断或治疗的有效性。

title: Alpha-TCM: A Nine-Layer Framework for TCM-Guided Multimodal Inference and Structured-Prior Auditing
zh_title: Alpha-TCM：中医引导的多模态推断九层框架与结构化先验审计
summary: 提出面向中医的九层可审计系统架构，并用合成数据原型验证第1-5层的知识-证据接口；明确为系统设计提案而非完整临床实现。
key_points: 九层架构分离领域知识、病例证据、概率推断与权限
每层明确信息契约、失效边界与验证状态

abstract: Alpha-TCM makes two contributions under a central thesis: auditable systems should separate domain knowledge, case evidence, probabilistic inference, and downstream authority. First, it proposes a nine-layer TCM-oriented architecture covering semantic definitions, multimodal acquisition, quality control, provenance-bearing knowledge, probabilistic inference, longitudinal updating, constrained decisions, language interaction, and human governance. Each layer specifies its information contract, failure boundary, dependencies, and validation status. This is a system-design proposal, not a claim of complete clinical implementation. Second, a controlled synthetic prototype instantiates Layers 1-5 to audit the knowledge-evidence interface. Four conditional-Gaussian encoders process synthetic tongue images, pulse waveforms, inquiry fields, and text, while a frozen bridge predicts a five-dimensional synthetic outcome. A versioned contextual prior is compiled independently of the renderer. Fusion removes duplicated reference-prior information before adding context. Equal-information controls, prior regularization, graded contamination, and structural corruption test contextual benefits, Bayesian specificity, and conflict detection. Across ten paired seeds and four training sizes, contextual knowledge improved mean absolute error over marginal committee fusion at 600 and 1,200 cases, but not over equal-information neural controls. Fully incorrect context harmed performance at every size, while prior effects were inconsistent and conflict scores did not track case-level damage. The results support contextual structure in low-data synthetic settings, not a specifically Bayesian advantage. The prototype establishes no claims about TCM theory or clinical, diagnostic, therapeutic, causal, longitudinal, or transfer validity.
zh_abstract: Alpha-TCM在一个核心论点下做出两项贡献：可审计系统应将领域知识、病例证据、概率推断和下游决策权限分离开来。第一，它提出了一个面向中医（TCM）的九层架构，涵盖语义定义、多模态采集、质量控制、带溯源信息的知识、概率推断、纵向更新、受约束的决策、语言交互和人类治理。每一层均规定了其信息契约、失效边界、依赖关系和验证状态。这是一项系统设计提案，并不声称已完成完整的临床实现。第二，一个受控的合成原型实例化了第1–5层，以审计知识与证据的接口。四个条件高斯编码器分别处理合成的舌象图像、脉搏波形、问诊字段和文本，同时一个冻结的桥接模块预测五维合成结局。一个版本化的情境先验独立于渲染器编译而成。融合在加入情境之前先去除重复的参考先验信息。等信息量对照、先验正则化、分级污染和结构性破坏被用于检验情境带来的益处、贝叶斯特异性和冲突检测。在十个配对随机种子和四种训练规模下，情境知识在600例和1,200例时相较于边缘委员会融合改善了平均绝对误差，但相较于等信息量神经对照则没有改善。完全错误的情境在每种规模下均损害性能，而先验效应不一致，冲突评分与病例层面的损害并不相符。结果支持在低数据合成情境下情境结构的作用，而不是特定的贝叶斯优势。该原型未对中医理论或临床、诊断、治疗、因果、纵向或迁移有效性作出任何主张。

title: Silhouette-Based Gaitomics for Frailty Assessment in Older Adults
zh_title: 基于轮廓步态组学的老年人衰弱评估
summary: 在66名老年人中，用步态轮廓提取90个描述符，结合特征选择与SHAP解释评估Fried衰弱表型，采用嵌套交叉验证。
key_points: 66名老年人，Fried衰弱表型为标签
90个形状、时序、运动与纹理描述符
嵌套分层交叉验证并用SHAP解释
